25Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth. 26-27Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
28Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
29-30Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.
The Temple Musicians
31After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship. 32These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
33-38Here is a list of these musicians and their family lines:
Heman from the Kohathite clan was the director. His ancestors went all the way back to Jacob and included Joel, Samuel, Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah, Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai, Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah, Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah, Izhar, Kohath, Levi.
39-43Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
44-47Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
48The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent.
The Descendants of Aaron
49Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
50-53Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz.
The Towns for the Levites
(Joshua 21.1-42)
54Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in. 55They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it. 56But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh. 57-59So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh. 60From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
61The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
62The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
63The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
64So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them. 65All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
66Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim. 67-69These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon. 70And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
71The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them. 72-73The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them. 74-75The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them. 76Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
77The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun. 78-79They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them. 80-81And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_text:
1Livai nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Gerson ale Koyat ale Merari.
2Koyat nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Amram ale Izyar ale Yebron ale Uzziel.
3Amram bisaŋa a jam le Aaron ale Moosis ale Miriam. Aaron nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Nadab ale Abiyu ale Eleaza ale Itamar. 4Eleaza jam ka Fineyas ko, Fineyas jam ka Abisua ko, 5Abisua jam ka Bukki ko, Bukki jam ka Uzzi ko, 6Uzzi jam ka Zerayia ko, Zerayia jam ka Meraiot ko, 7Meraiot jam ka Amariya ko, Amariya jam ka Ayitub ko, 8Ayitub jam ka Zadok ko, Zadok jam ka Ayimaaz ko, 9Ayimaaz jam ka Azariya ko, Azariya jam ka Joyanan ko, 10Joyanan jam ka Azariya ko, ka wa ale jam a tom Wen yenni ate Solomon a jam sɛ la po ase kaabteerɔ la Jerusalem po. 11Azariya a jam ka Amariya ko, Amariya jam ka Ayitub ko, 12Ayitub jam ka Zadok ko, Zadok jam ka Sallum ko, 13Sallum jam ka Yilkia ko, Yilkia jam ka Azariya ko, 14Azariya jam ka Seraiya ko, Seraiya jam ka Jeyozadak ko. 15Ba jam yik Jeyozadak a ta cheŋ kama diipo ate Naawen a basi ate Nebukadnezzar a yik Juda ale Jerusalem ale nisa a ta cheŋ yɔntidi po la.
16Livai nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Gerson ale Koyat ale Merari.
17Gerson mɛ nidoabilisaŋa yue a jam le Libni ale Simei.
18Koyat nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Amram ale Izyar ale Yebron ale Uzziel.
19Merari nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Mayali ale Musi. Bade a jam le Livai yezuimaŋa a ŋmarisi a ta va ba koma ale ka diila.
20Gerson nidoabili a jam le Libni. Libni nidoabili jam le Jeyat. Jeyat nidoabili jam le Zimmaya. Zimmaya mɛ nidoabili a jam le 21Joa. Joa nidoabili jam le Iddo. Iddo nidoabili jam le Zera. Zera nidoabili jam le Jeaterai.
22Koyat ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nna: Koyat nidoabili jam le Amminadab. Amminadab nidoabili jam le Koora. Koora nidoabili jam le Assir. Assir nidoabili jam le 23Elkana. Elkana nidoabili jam le Ebiasaf. Ebiasaf nidoabili jam le Assir. Assir nidoabili jam le 24Tayat. Tayat nidoabili jam le Uriel. Uriel nidoabili jam le Yuzaya. Yuzaya nidoabili jam le Sɛyaul.
25Elkana ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam le Amasai ale Ayimot. 26Ayimot nidoabili a jam le Elkana. Elkana nidoabili a jam le Zofai. Zofai nidoabili a jam le Nayat. 27Nayat nidoabili a jam le Eliab. Eliab nidoabili a jam le Jeroyam. Jeroyam nidoabili a jam le Elkana, Elkana nidoabili jam le Samuel.
28Samuel nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Joel nidoabili kpagni ale la a pasaŋ Abaija.
29Merari nidoabili a jam le Mayali. Mayali nidoabili a jam le Libni. Libni nidoabili a jam le Simei. Simei nidoabili a jam le Uzzaya. 30Uzzaya nidoabili a jam le Simea. Simea nidoabili a jam le Aggiya. Aggiya mɛ nidoabili a jam le Asaiya.
31Nuruma de ale Deevid a jam lueri ayen ba a nya yiilaŋa zuk Naawen yenni po diipo ate nɔiyeŋka dakanni a pilim jam bo dula la. 32Ba ale jam a tom diila ale ba a lenni yiila viuku po, tuka viuku. Ba jam a nye ka dila ate ku paari diipo ate Solomon a sɛ Naawen yeri a te Wen Jerusalem po la. Ba jam a tom ba tuimaŋa kama ase ba ale magsi ba a nye diila.
33Bade ale ba nidoabilisaŋa ale jam maari chaab a tom la. A nyini Koyat dɔkku buuni ka Yeman yilendika. Yeman jam ka Joel nidoabili. Joel jam ka Samuel nidoabili. 34Samuel jam ka Elkana nidoabili, Elkana jam ka Jeroyam nidoabili. Jeroyam jam ka Eliel nidoabili. Eliel jam ka Toaya nidoabili. 35Toaya jam ka Zuf nidoabili. Zuf jam ka Elkana nidoabili. Elkana jam ka Mayat nidoabili. Mayat jam ka Amasai nidoabili. 36Amasai jam ka Elkana nidoabili. Elkana jam ka Joel nidoabili. Joel jam ka Azariya nidoabili. Azariya jam ka Zefania nidoabili. 37Zefania jam ka Tayat nidoabili. Tayat jam ka Assir nidoabili. Assir jam ka Ebiasaf nidoabili, Ebiasaf jam ka Koora nidoabili. 38Koora mɛ jam ka Izyar nidoabili. Izyar jam ka Koyat nidoabili. Koyat jam ka Livai nidoabili, Livai mɛ jam ka Izirali nidoabili.
39Yeman maarɔwa Asaf waai ale jam bo wa juga geŋ la. Asaf jam ka Berekiya nidoabili. Berekiya jam ka Simea nidoabili. 40Simea jam ka Maakil nidoabili. Maakil jam ka Baaseiya nidoabili. Baaseiya jam ka Malkija nidoabili. 41Malkija jam ka Etni nidoabili. Etni jam ka Zera nidoabili. Zera jam ka Adaiya nidoabili. 42Adaiya jam ka Etan nidoabili. Etan jam ka Zimmaya nidoabili. Zimmaya jam ka Simei nidoabili. 43Simei jam ka Jayat nidoabili. Jayat jam ka Gerson nidoabili. Gerson jam ka Livai nidoabili.
44Merari dɔkdemma a jam le Yeman ale Asaf maarɔba, ba abe jam bo ka wa gala geŋsa. Tigsuŋku de po jam ka Kisi nidoabili Etan. Kisi jam ka Abdi nidoabili. Abdi jam ka Malluk nidoabinni. 45Malluk jam ka Yasabia nidoabili. Yasabia jam ka Amaziya nidoabili. Amaziya jam ka Yilkia nidoabili. 46Yilkia jam ka Amzi nidoabili. Amzi jam ka Bani nidoabili. Bani jam ka Sɛmer nidoabili. 47Sɛmer jam ka Mayali nidoabili. Mayali jam ka Musi nidoabili. Musi jam ka Merari nidoabili. Merari jam ka Livai nidoabili.
48Ba Livai chaama a jam a nya ka tuima nŋala zuk Wen yenni viuku po. 49Alege Aaron ale wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale jam a kaab juka tiirita kuŋkuŋku zuk ale a ju ŋan baai nyum ale masa la kuŋkuŋku zuk ale dii meena ale ta wari a nye ale Jigi Dii Ale Ŋmasi Ta Tuilum la, a nye biem duisi basika a te Izirali demma, a ta va chaab ale dii meena ate Moosis Wen tomteerɔwa a weeni la.
50Bade a jam le Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa. Eleaza jam ka Aaron nidoabili. Fineyas jam ka Eleaza nidoabili. Abisua jam ka Fineyas nidoabili. 51Bukki jam ka Abisua nidoabili. Uzzi jam ka Bukki nidoabili. Zerayia jam ka Uzzi nidoabili. 52Meraiot jam ka Bukki nidoabili. Amariya jam ka Meraiot nidoabili. Ayitub jam ka Amariya nidoabili. 53Zadok jam ka Ayitub nidoabili. Ayimaaz jam ka Zadok nidoabili.
54Kabtaŋa de ale Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam kali la. Wa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nyini Koyat dɔkku buuni la ale jam liŋ tuesi ba boka jigini. 55Ba jam te ba ka Yebron ale bo Juda po la a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa ale gilim ka la. 56Alege tattaŋa ale tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale gilim tɛŋ kpieŋka la ba jam pai te ka Jefunne nidoabinni Kaleb.
57Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa ba jam te ba ka Yebron tɛŋka, sukka tɛŋ. Ba jam maa te ba ka tɛŋsaŋa de, Libna ale Jattir ale Estemoa ale 58Yilen ale Debir ale 59Asan ale Jutta ale Bet Sɛmes a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsa. 60A nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni ba jam te ba ka Gibeon ale Geba ale Alemet ale Anatot a gum chaab ale si juijui ale ta wuuk la. Tɛŋsaŋa de ate ba jam chari te Koyat yezuimaŋa la meena jam ka pi ale sita.
61Koyat nidoabi nsila meena ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa pi a nyini Manasa buuni geli yezuimaŋa po.
62Gerson nidoabilisaŋa, yezuk yezuk, ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa pi ale sita a nyini Isaka ale Asɛ ale Nafitali diinaŋa buuni ale Manasa dɔkku buuni geli ale bo Basan po la.
63Merari nidoabilisaŋa, yezuk yezuk, ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa pi ale siye a ta nyini Aruben ale Gad ale Zebulun buuni po.
64Ka Izirali demma ale te Livaima tɛŋsaŋa de a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa. 65A nyini Juda ale Simeyon ale Benjamin buuni po ba te ba ka tɛŋ sii ate ba poom ŋaam wi si yueŋa la.
66Koyat yezuimaŋa gela ba jam te ba ka tɛŋsa a ta nyin Ɛfraim dɔkku buuni po. 67Guutaŋa ale bo tɛŋ kaai po ate ba a wi ayen Ɛfraim la, ba jam te ba ka Sikiim, sukka tɛŋ, ale Gezer ale 68Jokmeam ale Bet Yoron ale 69Aijalon ale Gat Arimmon a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
70A nyini Manasa dɔkku buuni genni jigi Izirali demma a jam te Koyat yezuimaŋa meena ale tali la ka Aner ale Bileam tɛŋsaŋa a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
71Gerson nidoabilisaŋa a jam tuesi ka tɛŋsaŋa de. A nyini Manasa dɔkku buuni genni yezukku ba jam tuesi ka Golan ale bo Basan po la ale Astarot a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
72A nyini Isaka dɔkku buuni ba jam tuesi ka Kedes ale Daberat ale 73Aramot ale Anem a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
74A nyini Asɛ dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Masal ale Abdon ale 75Yukok ale Areyob a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
76A nyini Nafitali dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Kedes ale bo Galili po la ale Yammon ale Kiriataim a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
77Merari nidoabilisaŋa, Livaima ale tali la, a jam tuesi ka tɛŋsaŋa de. A nyini Zebulun dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Arimmono ale Tabor a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
78A nyini Aruben dɔkku buuni a lo a jueli Jodan benni Jeriko kori geŋsa la ba jam tuesi ka Bezer ale bo sagni po la ale Jaza ale 79Kedemot ale Mefaat a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.
80A nyini Gad dɔkku buuni jigi ba jam tuesi ka Aramot ale bo Gilead po la ale Mayanaim ale 81Yesbon ale Jazer a gum chaab ale si wuuk tɛŋsaŋa.

english_text:
The Descendants of Issachar
1Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
2Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were 22,600 people in Tola's family by the time David became king.
3Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders. 4Their families were so large that they had 36,000 soldiers in their clans. 5In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of 87,000 warriors.
The Descendants of Benjamin and Dan
6Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
7Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was 22,034.
8Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. 9The official family records listed 20,200 soldiers in the families of this clan, as well as their family leaders.
10Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. 11They were family leaders in their clan, which had 17,200 soldiers prepared to fight in battle. 12Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan.
Dan was the father of Hushim.
The Descendants of Naphtali
13Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.
The Descendants of Manasseh
14Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead. 15Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah.
Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
16Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem. 17Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
18Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
19Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
The Descendants of Ephraim
20Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath, 21Zabad, and Shuthelah.
Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath. 22Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him. 23Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
24Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
25Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan, 26Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama, 27Nun, and Joshua.
28The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
29The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages.
The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages.
The Descendants of Asher
30Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
31Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith. 32Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua. 33Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. 34Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram. 35And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. 36Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, 37Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. 38Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
39Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
40These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of 26,000 soldiers.
translation_text:
1Isaka nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Tola ale Pua ale Jasub ale Simron. Ba meena ka banaansi.
2Tola nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Uzzi ale Arefaiya ale Jeriel ale Jamai ale Ibsam ale Samuel waai ale jam ka kpagi ba dɔkdemma po la. Deevid naamu vaaŋa po, Tola ŋaaŋbisaŋa ate ba jam ŋmarisi nidoama ase tugurik tɔŋdɔba la jam ka tusa pisiye ale ŋaye ale kobsiyuebi (22,600).
3Uzzi nidoabinni a jam le Izrayia. Izrayia mɛ nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Maakil ale Obadia ale Joel ale Issia. Banuwa meena jam ka nalima. 4A ta va ba gaŋka wie ale ka diila, ba jam taka nidoaba tusa pisita ale ŋayuebi (36,000) a magsi kpaliŋ nyeka, diila ba jam ta ka nipok boari ale bimbaansa. 5Kobirinni baai ale jam ka tugurik nyam la a jam nyini ka Isaka yezuimaŋa ase ba ale ŋmarisi ba wie diila. Ba meena jam ka tusa pinaanuŋ ale ŋayopɔi (87,000).
6Benjamin nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Bela ale Beker ale Jediael. Ba meena ka bata.
7Bela nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ezbon ale Uzzi ale Uzziel ale Jerimot ale Iri waai ale ka dɔkdemma kpagi la. Ba meena ka banu. Ba gaŋka tugurik nyama wie ale ŋmarisi doa la ka tusa kobsiye ale ŋaye ale pisita ale ŋanaansi (22,034).
8Beker nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Zemira ale Joas ale Ɛlieza ale Elioenai ale Omri ale Jeremot ale Abaija ale Anatot ale Alemet. Bade meena a jam ka Beker nidoabilisa. 9Ba ŋiaka gaŋka wieŋa po ba jam ŋmarisi ka niŋdeerɔba ale tugurik tɔŋdɔba tusa pisiye ale kobsiye (20,200).
10Jediael nidoabinni ale Bilyan. Bilyan nidoabilisaŋa mɛ a jam le Jeus ale Benjamin ale Eyud ale Chenaana ale Zetan ale Tarsis ale Ayisayar. 11Jediael nidoabilisaŋa de meena a jam ka yie nyam. Ba jam ka tusa pi ale ŋayopɔi ale kobsiye (17,200) tugurik nyam a gomsi magsi ba cheŋ ga nye kpaliŋ.
12Ir nidoabilisaŋa a jam ka Suppim ale Yuppim. Ayer nidoabili a jam le Yusim.
13Nafitali nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Jaziel ale Guni ale Jezer ale Sallum, Bilya ŋaaŋbisa ale la.
14Manasa ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale nna: Asriel jam ka wa ŋaaŋbiik. Manasa powa Araam tɛŋka liewa ale jam biak wa. Nipok wala ale jam biak Gilead kowa Makir. 15Makir a jam faari ka nipok a ta nyini Yuppim ale Suppim po. Wa toawa yuei a jam le Maaka. Ŋaaŋbiik ka choa yuei jam le Zelofehad, wa jam biak ka lieba nyiini.
16Makir powa Maaka a jam biak ka nidoabili a te wa yuei ayen Peres. Wa suoku yuei jam le Seres. Peres nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ulam ale Arakem.
17Ulam nidoabili a jam le Bedan. Gilead nidoabilisaŋa a jam le bade, wa ko ale chim Makir. Makir jam ka Manasa ko. 18Gilead toawa Yammoleket ale jam biak Isod ale Abiezer ale Mala.
19Sɛmida nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ayian ale Sikiim ale Likyi ale Aniam.
20Ɛfraim ŋaaŋbisaŋa yue ale nna. Ɛfraim nidoabinni a jam le Sutela. Sutela nidoabinni ale Bered. Bered nidoabinni ale Tayat. Tayat nidoabinni ale Eleada. Eleada nidoabinni a jam le Tayat. 21Tayat nidoabinni a jam le Zabad. Zabad nidoabinni a jam le Sutela. Ezer ale Elead a jam cheŋ ka Gat tɛŋka ayen ba vari duŋ buulim ate nuru baai ale bo tɛŋ kpieŋka po la a ko ba. 22Ba kowa Ɛfraim a jam kum ba nyiŋ ka da boari ate wa kobisaŋa a jam ba yik wa. 23Wa jam goa ale wa powa kama ŋmana ate wa yik lɔgi a biak nidoabili. Wa jam te wa yuei ayen ka Beriya dii nyiŋla zubiok ale jam bo wa yenni po. 24Wa lie jam le Seera, waai ale jam se Tɛŋ Bet Yoron ale Ŋmai Bet Yoron ale Uzzen Seera.
25Arefaya jam ka Beriya nidoabili, Aresef jam ka Arefaya nidoabili, Tela jam ka Aresef nidoabili, Tayan jam ka Tela nidoabili, 26Ladan jam ka Tayan nidoabili, Ammiyud jam ka Ladan nidoabili, Elisama jam ka Ammiyud nidoabili, 27Nun jam ka Elisama nidoabili, Josua jam ka Nun nidoabili.
28Ba tɛŋsaŋa ale ba kalisaŋa jiŋŋa a jam le Betel ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ate Naaran a bo kori geŋsa, Gezer ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a bo yeniŋ geŋsa ate Sikiim ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa a ga paari Ayya ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa. 29Tɛŋ sii ale bo Manasa tɛŋ banni la ale Bet San ale Taanak ale Megiddo ale Dor a gum chaab ale si tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa. Izirali nidoabinni Josefi ŋaaŋbisaŋa a jam bo ka tɛŋ kpieŋsaŋa de po.
30Asɛ nidoabilisaŋa ale nna: Asɛ nidoabilisaŋa jam le Imnaya ale Isva ale Isvi ale Beriya. Ba toa jam le Seraya.
31Beriya nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ɛba ale Malkiel. Malkiel jam ka Birzait ko.
32Ɛba jam ka Jaflet ale Somer ale Yotam ale ba toawa Sɛyua ko.
33Jaflet nidoabilisaŋa jam le Pasak ale Bimyal ale Asvat. Bade jam le Jaflet nidoabilisaŋa.
34Somer nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ayi ale Aroyaga ale Yubba ale Araam.
35Wa suoku Yelem nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Zofa ale Imna ale Seles ale Amal.
36Zofa nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Suaya ale Yarnefer ale Sual ale Beri ale Imra ale 37Bezer ale Yod ale Samma ale Silsa ale Itran ale Beera.
38Jeter nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Jefunne ale Pispa ale Ara.
39Ulla nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Araya ale Yanniel ale Arizia.
40Bade meena jam ka Asɛ ŋaaŋbisa, yie nyam, baai ate ba lueri, kpaliŋdɔ pagrisa, niŋdeerɔ baai ale potim za nalimnyiini. Nidoa baai ale gomsi magsi kpaliŋ, ase ba le ŋmarisi ba ŋiak wieŋa po la jam ka tusa pisiye ale ŋayuebi (26,000).

english_text:
More Descendants of Benjamin
1Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah, 2Nohah, and Rapha. 3Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud, 4Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, 5Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
6-7Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
8-11Shaharaim and his wife Hushim had two sons: Abitub and Elpaal. But Shaharaim later divorced her and his other wife, Baara. Then he moved to the country of Moab and married Hodesh, and they had seven sons: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. They were all family leaders in his clan. 12Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
13Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath. 14-16Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha. 17-18Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab. 19-21Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath. 22-25Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel. 26-27Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri. 28These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
29Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there 30along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 31Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, 32and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
The Descendants of King Saul
33Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 34Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, 35and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz. 36Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, 37Binea, Raphah, Eleasah, Azel, 38as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. 39Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet. 40Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of 150 children and grandchildren.
All of these belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_text:
1Benjamin jam ka Bela ko, wa nidoabili kpagni ale la. Asbel ale pasaŋ ate butawa po a chim Ayara ate 2Noya a saari banaansi ate bunuwa po a chim Arafa.
3Bela nidoabilisaŋa a jam ka Addar ale Gera ale Abiyud ale 4Abisua ale Naaman ale Ayoa ale 5Gera ale Sefufan ale Yuram.
6Bade a jam le Eyud ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale chim yie nyam Geba po. Baai ate ba jam fɛ ba ate ba cheŋ Manahat la ale nna: 7Naaman ale Ayija ale Gera waai ale jam fɛ ba ate ba ŋmani cheŋ la. Gera jam ka Uzza ale Ayiyud ko.
8Ba jam biak ka nidoabilisa a te Sayaraim Moab tɛŋka po wa ale jam basi wa pooma Yusim ale Baara la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 9Wa powa Yodes a jam biak ka Jobab ale Zibia ale Mesa ale Malkam ale 10Jeuz ale Sakia ale Mirma. Bade a jam le wa nidoabilisaŋa. Ba jam ka yie nyam. 11Yusim jam biak ka Abitub ale Elpaal.
12Elpaal nidoabilisaŋa jam ka Eber ale Misam ale Sɛmed. Sɛmed ale jam sɛ Ono ale Lod ale ka tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa, 13Beriya ale Sɛma ale jam ka Elpaal nidoabilisa la jam chim ka niŋdeerɔba a te baai ale jam bo Aijalon la, bala dek ale jam yiak baai ale bo Gat po la a basi.
14Beriya nidoabilisaŋa jam ka Ayio ale Sasak ale Jeremot ale 15Zebadia ale Arad ale Eder ale 16Maakil ale Ispa ale Joya.
17Elpaal nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Zebadia ale Mesullam ale Yizki ale Ɛba 18ale Ismerai ale Izlia ale Jobab.
19Simei nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Jakim ale Zikri ale Zabdi ale 20Elienai ale Zilletai ale Eliel ale 21Adaiya ale Beraiya ale Simrat.
22Sasak nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ispan ale Eber ale Eliel ale 23Abdon ale Zikri ale Yanan ale 24Yanania ale Iilam ale Antotija ale 25Ifdeya ale Penuel.
26Jeroyam nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Samserai ale Seyaria ale Ataliaya ale 27Jaaresia ale Elaja ale Zikri.
28Bade meena jam ka yie nyam ale nalima ase ku le ŋmarisi ba ŋiaka wie diila, ba jam bo ka Jerusalem tɛŋka po.
29Gibeon kowa a jam boka Gibeon tɛŋka po. Wa powa yuei jam le Maaka, 30wa nidoabili kpagni yuei jam le Abdon a pasaŋ Zur ate Kis pasaŋ ate Baal pasaŋ ate Nadab pasaŋ ate 31Gedor pasaŋ ate Ayio pasaŋ ate Zeker pasaŋ ate 32Miklot a kpeglim nisa, waai ale jam ka Simeaya ko la. Ba mɛ a jam boro a moata ka ba kobisaŋa Jerusalem po.
33Ner jam ka Kis ko, Kis jam ka Sɔɔl ko, Sɔɔl jam ka Jonatan ale Malki Sua ale Abinadab ale Es Baal ko.
34Jonatan nidoabili a jam le Merib Baal, waai ale jam ka Maika ko la.
35Maika nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Piton ale Melek ale Tarea ale Ayazi. 36Ayazi jam ka Jeyoadda ko, Jeyoadda jam ka Alemet ale Azmavet ale Zimri ko. Zimri jam ka Moza ko. 37Moza jam ka Binea ko. Arafaya jam ka wa nidoabili, Eleasaya jam ka Arafaya nidoabili, Azel jam ka Eleasaya nidoabili.
38Azel a jam ta ka nidoabilisa bayuebi. Ba yueŋa abe le Azrikam ale Bokeru ale Ismael ale Searia ale Obadia ale Yanan. Bade meena jam ka Azel nidoabilisa.
39Wa suoku Esek nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Ulam kpagni ale la ate Jeus a pasaŋ, butawa po ka Elifelet. 40Ulam nidoabilisaŋa jam ka baai ale toa baai ale seba tom tɔŋka. Ba jam ta ka nidoabi boari ale ŋaaŋbi boari, ba meena jam ka kook ale pisinu. Bade meena jam ka Benjamin nidoabilisa.

english_text:
The People Who Returned from Babylonia and Settled in Jerusalem
1Everyone in Israel was listed in the official family records that were included in the history of Israel's kings.
The people of Judah were taken to Babylonia as prisoners because they sinned against the Lord. 2 And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites. 3People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
4-6There were 690 people from the Judah tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They were all descendants of Judah's three sons: Perez, Shelah, and Zerah. Their leaders were Uthai, Asaiah, and Jeuel. Uthai was the son of Ammihud and a descendant of Omri, Imri, Bani, and Perez. Asaiah was a descendant of Shelah; Jeuel was a descendant of Zerah.
7-9There were also 956 family leaders from the Benjamin tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They included: Sallu son of Meshullam, grandson of Hodaviah, and great-grandson of Hassenuah; Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi and grandson of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, grandson of Reuel, and great-grandson of Ibnijah.
The Priests Who Settled in Jerusalem
10-12Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
13There was a total of 1,760 priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple.
The Levites Who Settled in Jerusalem
14-16Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah.
The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
17Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan, 18and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
19Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent. 20Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
21Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
22There was a total of 212 guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work, 23and now they guarded the temple gates.
24There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple. 25Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty. 26The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there. 27They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning.
The Duties of the Levites
28Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used. 29Others were responsible for the temple furnishings and its sacred objects, as well as the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices. 30But only the priests could mix the spices. 31Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings. 32The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
33The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
34All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem.
King Saul's Family
(1 Chronicles 8.29-38)
35Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived. 36They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 37Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth 38the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
39Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 40-41Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz. 42-44The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_text:
1Izirali demma meena yueŋa a jam ŋmarisi kama ase ba ŋiak wieŋa ale ka diila a bo nalima gbaŋka po. Juda demma ba jam nak yik ba kama a ta cheŋ Babilon tɛŋka dii nyiŋla ba ale kan ta wensie la nyiŋ. 2Baai ale dɛ niŋ a ŋman pilim kali badek nitalim po ale badek tɛŋsaŋa po la jam ka Izirali demma gela ale kaabteerɔba ale Livaiba ale Naawen yenni tomteerɔba.
3Baai ale nyini Juda ale Benjamin ale Ɛfraim ale Manasa a bo Jerusalem la jam le nna: 4Utai jam ka Ammiyud nidoabili. Ammiyud jam ka Omri nidoabili. Omri jam ka Imri nidoabili. Imri jam ka Bani nidoabili. Bani jam ka Perezi ŋaaŋbiik. Perezi jam ka Juda nidoabili. 5A nyini Silon demma po. Asaiya ale kpagni ale wa nidoabilisa. 6A nyini Zera demma po jam ka Jeuel. Nuruma ale nyini Juda la jam ka kobsiyuebi ale pineok. 7A nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni jam ka Mesullam nidoabinni Sallu. Mesullam jam ka Yodavia nidoabili. Yodavia jam ka Yassenuya nidoabili. 8Ibneiya jam ka Jeroyam nidoabili. Elaya jam ka Uzzi nidoabili. Uzzi jam ka Mikri nidoabili. Mesullam jam ka Sefatia nidoabili. Sefatia jam ka Areuel nidoabili. Areuel jam ka Ibnija nidoabili. 9Nuruma ale nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni po a ŋmarisi bo ba ŋiak wieŋa po la jam ka nuruba kobsaneok ale pisinu ale bayuebi a bo Jerusalem tɛŋka po. Nuruma de meena jam ka yie nyam.
10A nyini kaabteerɔma po jam ka Jedaya ale Jeyoiarib ale Jakin. 11Azariya jam ka Yilkia nidoabili. Yilkia jam ka Mesullam nidoabili. Mesullam jam ka Zadok nidoabili. Zadok jam ka Meraiot nidoabili. Meraiot jam ka Ayitub nidoabili. Ayitub jam le kpagi a nya Wen yenni zuk. 12Ba gela mɛ ale Adaiya wa jam ka Jeroyam nidoabili. Jeroyam jam ka Pasur nidoabili. Pasur jam ka Malkija nidoabili ale Maasai jam ka Adiel nidoabili. Adiel jam ka Jazera nidoabili. Jazera jam ka Mesullam nidoabili. Mesullam jam ka Mesillemit nidoabili. Mesillemit jam ka Immer nidoabili. 13Kaabteerɔma baai ale jam ka yie nyam la ka tusidi ale kobsiyopɔi ale pisiyuebi (1,760). Ba jam ka nuru baai ale baga a tom Wen yenni tuimaŋa la.
14A nyini Livaima po ka Yassub nidoabinni Sɛmaiya. Yassub jam ka Azrikam nidoabili. Azrikam jam ka Yasabia nidoabili. Yasabia a nyini ka Merari dɔkdemma po. 15Ba gela a jam le Bakbakkar ale Yeres ale Galal ale Mika nidoabinni Mattania. Mika jam ka Zikri nidoabili. Zikri jam ka Asaf nidoabili. 16Ba gela mɛ a jam le Sɛmaiya nidoabinni Obadia. Sɛmaiya jam ka Galal nidoabili. Galal jam ka Jedutun nidoabili ale Asa nidoabinni Berekiya. Asa jam ka Elkana nidoabili, waai ale jam bo Netofat demma tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa po la.
17Nansuiŋ limisidɔma jam le Sallum ale Akkub ale Talmon ale Ayiman ale ba suataŋa. Sallum jam le ba niŋdeerɔ a 18bo naawa nansuiŋku nɔi kori geŋsa a ta jam paari vaaŋa de po. Bade ma a jam le nansuiŋ limisidɔma a nyini Livaima po la. 19Sallum jam ka Kore nidoabili. Kore jam ka Ebiasaf nidoabili. Ebiasaf jam ka Koora nidoabili. Sallum ale wa kobisaŋa ale nyini Koora dɔkdemma po la jam ka nansuiŋ limisidɔba ale maara limisi Wen yenni ase ba koma ale jam a nya nansuiŋku ale a jo Naawen boka jigini la. 20Piilimka po Eleaza nidoabinni Fineyas ale jam a nya nansuiŋ limisidɔma zuk ate Naawen a bo ale wa. 21Meselemia nidoabinni Zakaria a jam le Tuka Viuku nansuiŋ nyaarɔwa.
22A gum chaab baai meena ate ba jam lueri ayen ba chim limisidɔba la jam ka nuruba kobsiye ale pi ale baye. Ba jam ŋmarisi ba ase ka ba ŋiaka wie ale jam ka dii ba tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa po la. Nansuiŋ nyaarɔma ka Deevid ale Samuel biisiteerɔwa ale jam lueri ba a zaani dula ale sebchakka. 23Ba ale ba ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale jam a nya Naawen yenni nansuiŋtaŋa zuk, yie dii ate ba a wi ayen viuk la. 24Nansuiŋ ligrisaŋa a jam bo ka kabta bunaansiwa. Kori ale yeniŋ ale wiiluk ale Yeseoku. 25Ba suataŋa a nyiem basi ka ba tɛŋ kpaŋsaŋa ale jam tagri ba daa ŋayopɔi. 26Alege nansuiŋ ligrɔ kpaga ŋanaansiwa, baai ale jam ka Livaiba la ate ba ta sebchakka ale ba la, ba pai diinaŋa ale ligraŋa Wen yenni po a nyo ka ba nisima po. 27Ba ale boro ka yokku meena a gilim Wen yenni, dii nyiŋla ba magsi ba a limisi di kama, ba abe ta saafiik kama a lak di saluik meena.
28Ba gela ale jam a nya ŋan baai ate ba taa tom Wen yenni po la, ba nyiem a chiini kama diipo ate ba ta ba a jo la ale diipo ate ba ta ba a nyini la. 29Ba gela mɛ ate ba basi ate ba a nya ŋantomta ale ŋan yona zuk Wen yenni po ale zommu ale daamu ale kpaamu ale ŋan baai nyum ale masa la. 30Alege kaabteerɔma gela ale jam a dam ŋan baai nyum ale masa la. 31Livai ale jam boro wa yuei jam le Mattitia, Koora denɔwa Sallum nidoabi kpagi, ate ba ta sebchakka ale wa a pai tiirim kaabka boroboroku seka a te wa ase wa tuini la. 32Ba suataŋa Koyat kabini gela ale jam a gomsi Vuusum dai boroboroku jazaanimu zuk dai meena.
33Baai ale jam ka yilendisa la, yie nyam Livai dɔkdemma po la, a jam bo ka Wen yenni diinaŋa po ale kan tom tuin yoŋŋoa, dii nyiŋla ba ale jam a nya tuini zuk danni po ale yok meena. 34Bade meena jam ka yie nyam Livai dɔkdemma po. Kpaga ase ba le ŋmarisi dii ba ŋiak wieŋa po la, ba jam bo ka Jerusalem po.
35Gibeon kowa Jeiel a jam bo ka Gibeon tɛŋka po. Wa powa yuei jam le Maaka, 36wa nidoabili kpagni jam le Abdon a pasaŋ Zur a pai te Kis ate wa mɛ a pai te Baal ate Ner pasaŋ ate Nadab pasaŋ ate 37Gedor pasaŋ ate Ayio pasaŋ ate Zakaria pasaŋ ate Miklot a kpeglim nisa. 38Miklot jam ka Simeam ko. Ba mɛ a jam kali moata ka ba kobisaŋa Jerusalem tɛŋka po.
39Ner jam ka Kis ko. Kis jam ka Sɔɔl ko. Sɔɔl jam ka Jonatan ale Malki Sua ale Abinadab ale Es Baal ko.
40Jonatan jam ka Merib Baal ko. Merib Baal a jam ka Maika ko. 41Maika nidoabilisaŋa a jam le Piton ale Melek ale Tarea. 42Ayazi jam ka Jara ko. Jara jam ka Alemet ale Azmavet ale Zimri ko. Zimri jam ka Moza ko. 43Moza jam ka Binea ko. Arefaiya jam ka Binea nidoabili. Eleasaya jam ka Arefaiya nidoabili. Azel jam ka Eleasaya nidoabili. 44Azel jam ta ka nidoabilisa bayuebi. Bala ale Azrikam ale Bokeru ale Ismael ale Searia ale Obadia ale Yanan. Ba jam ka Azel nidoabilisa.

english_text:
King Saul and His Sons Die
(1 Samuel 31.1-13)
1The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed. 2The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua. 3The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
4Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.”
But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade. 5When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
6Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead. 7The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
8The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa, 9they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods. 10They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
11When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul, 12some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
13 Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead, 14instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
1Filistia demma a jam kpaliŋ ale Izirali demma. Izirali demma a jam chali kama, ate ba yega a kpi Gilboa Guuku zuk. 2Filistia demma jam a vi Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisaŋa ka nna kparikpari a ko wa nidoabilisaŋa Jonatan ale Abinadab ale Malki Sua. 3Kpaliŋka a jam pagra kama a gilim Sɔɔl ate tɔŋdɔma a tɔŋ wa ale ba peemaŋa, ba jam koani wa kama.
4Sɔɔl a jam weeni wa kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔwa kama ayen, <<Yeeri fi gebika a chub mu, kan daa di Filistia demma ale kan gebi ba yoaŋa la ale jam nyo mu chivie po.>> Alege wa kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔwa a jam yɔgsa kama ale wa le nye dila, dila Sɔɔl yaa yeeri wadek gebika a yɔk lo ka zuk. 5Ase kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔwa ale nya ale Sɔɔl a kpi la, wa mɛ yaa lo wa gebika zuk a kpi. 6Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisa batawa a jam kpi kama, wa dɔkdemma meena a jam kpi ka wayeŋ.
7Ase Izirali demma meena ale jam bo viaka po la ale jam nya ale tugurik tommu a chali, ate Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisaŋa kpi la, ba yaa banti ba tɛŋsaŋa ale chali. Ate Filistia demma a jam kali si po.
8Dai dii ale pasaŋ la, ase Filistia demma ale jam ba kɔlim kpiema ŋantaŋa la, ba yaa nya ale Sɔɔl ale wa nidoabilisaŋa a kpi doa Gilboa Guuku zuk. 9Ba jam yeeri wa kpaliŋ ŋantaŋa kama a ta ba ale wa zukku a cheŋ ale tom nuruba Filistia tɛŋka po meena ate ba ga mooli wapaalaŋa a te ba wenaŋa ale ba nuruma. 10Ba jam pai wa kpaliŋ kɔlimaŋa a nyo ka ba wenaŋa dɔkku po ale pai wa zukku a saŋ ba wenni Dagon dɔkku po.
11Ase Jabes Gilead demma meena ale ga wom dii meena ate Filistia demma a nye Sɔɔl la, 12ba nidoa tuasaŋa meena yaa ga pai Sɔɔl nyiŋka ale wa nidoabilisaŋa nyiŋsaŋa a ta jam Jabes. Ba jam gu ba kobaŋa ka Jabes tiib kpiemu kiri ale bobi nɔi daa ŋayopɔi.
13Sɔɔl a jam kpi kama dii nyiŋla wa jam ka wensie ale Naawen ya, wa an jam ta Naawen wanni ale cheŋ nipok sampoporik jigi a yaali ganika ale 14an begi Naawen ya. Dila nyiŋ ate Naawen a ko wa ale pai naamu a te Jese nidoabinni Deevid.

english_text:
David Becomes King of Israel
(2 Samuel 5.1-3)
1Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives, 2and we know that you have led our army into battle, even when Saul was still our king. The Lord God has promised that you would rule our country and take care of us like a shepherd. 3So we have come to crown you king of Israel.”
David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said.
David Captures Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 5.6-10)
4 Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town. 5The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
6David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
7Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David. 8He had the city rebuilt, starting at the landfill on the east side. Meanwhile, Joab supervised the repairs to the rest of the city.
9David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side.
The Three Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.8-17)
10The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
11The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed 300 men with his spear.
12Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. 13During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away, 14except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
15One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley 16and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress, 17and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
18The Three Warriors sneaked through the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. They took it back to David, but he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured out the water as a sacrifice to the Lord 19and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.”
The Three Warriors did these brave deeds.
The Thirty Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.18-39)
20Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed 300 men with his spear. He was just as famous as the Three Warriors 21and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
22Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion. 23Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it. 24Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors, 25even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
26-47Here is a list of the other famous warriors:
Asahel the brother of Joab; Elhanan the son of Dodo from Bethlehem; Shammoth from Haror; Helez from Pelon; Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa; Abiezer from Anathoth; Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai the Ahohite; Maharai from Netophah; Heled the son of Baanah from Netophah; Ithai the son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin; Benaiah from Pirathon; Hurai from near the streams on Mount Gaash; Abiel from Arbah; Azmaveth from Baharum; Eliahba from Shaalbon; Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan the son of Shagee from Harar; Ahiam the son of Sachar the Hararite; Eliphal the son of Ur; Hepher from Mecherah; Ahijah from Pelon; Hezro from Carmel; Naarai the son of Ezbai; Joel the brother of Nathan; Mibhar the son of Hagri; Zelek from Ammon; Naharai from Beeroth who carried Joab's weapons; Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite; Uriah the Hittite; Zabad the son of Ahlai; Adina the son of Shiza, a leader in the Reuben tribe, and 30 of his soldiers; Hanan the son of Maacah; Joshaphat from Mithan; Uzzia from Ashterah; Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham from Aroer; Jediael and Joha the sons of Shimri from Tiz; Eliel from Mahavah; Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam; Ithmah from Moab; Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel from Mezobah.
translation_text:
1Izirali demma meena yaa jam jigi yeŋ a cheŋ Deevid jigi Yebron po ayen, <<Tama ka fidek nyiŋlam ale ziim. 2Bena ale taam la, diipo ate Sɔɔl a chim naab la, ka fi ale jam de Izirali demma niŋ tugurik tom kpaliŋsaŋa po. Ate Naawen dii ale ka fi Wenni la a weeni fu ayen, <Fi ale chim naapeerik a kasi mi nuruma Izirali demma abe fi a nya ba zuk.> >>
3Ase Izirali nisɔmma ale jan jam Naab Deevid jigi Yebron tɛŋka po la, wa yaa nye nɔiyeŋ ale ba Yebron po Naawen niŋ, ba jam bobi Deevid ka naab ate wa a nya Izirali zuk ase Naawen ale jam puulim dii ale Samuel la.
4Deevid ale Izirali demma meena yaa gɔk santiri a cheŋ Jerusalem, Jebus ale la. Jebus demma baai ale jam bo dula la 5a weeni Deevid ayen, <<Fi a kan jo dela.>> Alege Deevid a jam nak yik Zayon tɛŋka ate parik pagrisa a gilim ka la, Deevid tɛŋ kpieŋka.
6Deevid jam weeni ayen, <<Nuru waai ale wa siti Jebus demma la ale chim ka kpagi a nya mi tugurik tommu zuk.>> Zeruiya nidoabinni Joab ale jam dɛ niŋ, dila wa yaa tuesi kpaŋtaŋa.
7Deevid yaa jam bo tɛŋka ate ba sɛ parisa a gilim la po, dila nyiŋ ka yuei jam le Deevid tɛŋ. 8Deevid yaa ŋman sɛ tɛŋka, a piilim juijui ate ba palinti tɛŋka la a cheŋ parika ale gilim tɛŋka la. Joab mɛ ale jam gomsi tɛŋka kabitaŋa gela. 9Ate Deevid yaa jam ŋmasi pagra a gum du dii nyiŋla Naawen Dii Ale A Dɛ Tugurik Tɔŋdɔma Niŋ La ale jam bo ale wa.
10Bade a jam le Deevid nuru kpientaŋa niŋdeerɔba baai ale jam maari ate wa naamu a pagra la. Nuruma de ale Izirali meena a jam maari Deevid naamu kama ate bu teeri paari tɛŋka meena, ase Naawen ale puulim la. 11Bade a jam le Deevid nuru kpientaŋa. Yachmoni denɔwa Jasobeam ale jam chim kpaŋŋa kpagi, wa jam pai wa gbaluku a ko ka nuruba kobsita, wa jam ko ba ka kpaliŋ yeŋ po.
12Waai ale pasaŋ wa la ka Ayoyi denɔwa Dodai nidoabinni Eleaza, wa jam ka nuru kpienta batawa po wanyi. 13Wa jam bo ale ka Deevid Pas Dammim po, ate Filistia demma a tigsi dula a magsi kpaliŋ la. Juijui ate za a boro la, tugurik tommu a jam yiti chali kama ale basi Filistia demma. 14Alege talimu suŋsuŋ ba jam chiib zaani kama. Ba jam zɛri ka badek nyiŋ a chub Filistia demma a lɔnsi, ate Naawen a te ba nak dɛka.
15Nuruba bata ale nyini tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaga pisitawa po a jam Deevid jigi piuŋku vɔrumu ale bo Adullam po la, alege ate Filistia tugurik tɔŋdɔma a bo Arefaim Viaka po. 16Dila po Deevid jam bo ka pagrimu jigini, alege ate Filistia demma tugurik tɔŋdɔma tigsuŋku a bo Betiliyem. 17Deevid yaa jam a yaali nyiam a weeni ayen, <<Dan ka waai ate wa yaali nyiam vinni ale moata Betiliyem nansuiŋku la a te mu.>> 18Nuru pagrisaŋa batawa yaa cheŋ va Filistia demma tomtomaŋa po a ga ŋari nyiam vinni ale moata Betiliyem nansuiŋku la a ji bu ta ga te Deevid. Alege wa zɛri wa an nyu ya, wa goanti kpiiri bu basi ka Naawen niŋ, 19ale weeni ayen, <<Ku yalima ale mi Wen yaa, ate mi a nye kude. Ku ale nye ase mi a nyu ka nuruma de ziim la, baai ale kan kpaliŋ ba nyuvooŋa nyiŋ a ta bu jam te mi la.>> Dila nyiŋ Deevid a jam zɛri kama an nyu bu. Nuru pagrisaŋa de batawa ale jam nye diila ale nna.
20Joab suoku Abisai ale jam chim Pisitawa kpagi. Wa jam pai wa gbaluku a tu chaab ale ka nuruba kobsita, baai ate wa ko, ate wa yuei a yiti ase mbala Pisitawa la. 21Wa jam ta zula a gaam mbala Pisitawa ale chim ba kpagi, alege wa jam daa Batawa po.
22Jeyoiada nidoabinni Benaya ale nyini Kabzeel la, a jam tua kama ale kpaliŋ nyeka, waai ale jam nye wakpiema nna yegayega. Wa jam ko ka Moab tɛŋka nidoaba dek baye. Wa jam siŋ ka vɔrup po mɛ ŋmoruk tana dai a ko gbeŋli. 23Wa jam ko Ejipiti tɛŋka denɔ waai woglim ale jam paari ka anamagib pi. Ejipiti denɔwa a jam ta ka gbaluk wa nisaŋa po ase yɔgdɔ chib la, alege Benaya a jam siti wa kama ale doari. Wa jam chiak gbaluku kama Ejipiti denɔwa nisa po a ko wa ale wadek gbaluku. 24Wieŋa de ate Jeyoiada nidoabinni Benaya a jam nye la. Wa jam ta yuei ase ka mbala Batawa la. 25Wa jam nya zula a gaam mbala Pisitawa meena kama, alege wa an jam gum nuruba Batawa po. Ate Deevid a basi ate wa a nya wa ganidɔma zuk.
26Wa nuru kpientaŋa ale nna: Joab suoku Asayel ale Dodo nidoabinni Elhanan a nyini Betiliyem ale 27Yaror denɔwa Sammot ale Pelon denɔwa Yelez ale 28Ikkes nidoabinni Ira ale nyini Tekoa la ale Abiezer ale nyini Anatot la 29ale Sibbekai ale ka Yusat denɔ la ale Ilai ale ka Ayoyi denɔ la ale 30Mayarai ale ka Netofat denɔ la ale Baanaya nidoabinni Yeled ale ka Netofat denɔ la ale 31Itai ale ka Aribai nidoabili a nyini Gibea ale bo Benjamin tɛŋka po la ale Benaya ale ka Piraton denɔ la. Ba gela ale 32Yurai a nyini Gaas vooliŋka geŋsa la ale Abiel ale ka Arbat denɔ la ale 33Azmavet ale ka Bayarum denɔ la ale Eliahba ale ka Saalbon denɔ la ale 34Gizon denɔwa Yasem nidoabilisaŋa jam le, Sagee nidoabinni Jonatan ale ka Yarar denɔ la ale 35Sakar nidoabinni Ayiam ale ka Yarar denɔ la ale Ur nidoabinni Elifal ale 36Yefer ale ka Mekerat denɔ la ale Ayija ale ka Pelon denɔ la ale 37Yezro ale ka Karmel denɔ la ale Ezbai nidoabinni Naarai ale 38Joel ale ka Natan suok la ale Yagri nidoabinni Mibyar ale 39Zelek ale ka Ammon denɔ la ale Nayarai ale ka Beerot denɔ la. Nayarai jam ka Zeruiya nidoabili Joab kpaliŋ kɔlima jiirɔ. Mbala mɛ ale 40Itri denɔwa Ira ale Itri denɔwa Gareb ale 41Yit denɔwa Yuraya ale Alai nidoabinni Zabad ale 42Siza nidoabinni Adina ale ka Aruben dɔkku denɔ la. Adina jam ka Aruben dɔkku kpagi ale nuruba pisitawa ale bo ale wa la. 43Mbala ale Maaka nidoabinni Yanan ale Mitni denɔwa Josafat ale 44Asterat denɔwa Uzzia ale Yotam nidoabilisaŋa Sama ale Jeiel. Yotam ale ka Aroer denɔ la. 45Mbala jam le Simri nidoabinni Jediael, wa suoku Joya ale ka Tizi denɔ la ale 46Mayav denɔwa Eliel ale Elnaam nidoabilisaŋa Jeribai ale Josavia, ale Moab denɔwa Itma ale 47Eliel ale Obed ale Mezoba denɔwa Jaasiel.

english_text:
David's Men at Ziklag
1Some time earlier, David had gone to live in the town of Ziklag to escape from King Saul. While David was there, several brave warriors joined him to help fight his battles.
Warriors from the Benjamin tribe
2Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand. 3-7Their leaders were Ahiezer and Joash, the sons of Shemaah from Gibeah. Here is a list of those men from Benjamin: Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah and Jehu from Anathoth; Ishmaiah from Gibeon, who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad from Gederah; Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah from Haruph; Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam from the Korah clan; Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
Warriors from the Gad tribe
8Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears. 9-13There were eleven of them, ranked in the following order: Ezer the leader, then Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, and Machbannai.
14All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops. 15Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river.
Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
16One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying. 17David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
18Amasai, who later became the leader of the Thirty Warriors, was one of these men who went to David. God's Spirit took control of him, and he said, “We will join you, David son of Jesse! You and your followers will always be successful, because God fights on your side.”
So David agreed to let them stay, and he even put them in charge of his soldiers who raided enemy villages.
Warriors from the Manasseh tribe
19Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag. 20That's when the following men from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. They had all been commanders in Saul's army 21and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
22Day after day, new men came to join David, and soon he had a large, powerful army.
David's Men at Hebron
23-37The kingdom of Israel had been taken away from Saul, and it now belonged to David. He was ruling from Hebron, and thousands of well-trained soldiers from each tribe went there to crown David king of all Israel, just as the Lord had promised. These soldiers, who were always prepared for battle, included: 6,800 from Judah, who were armed with shields and spears; 7,100 from Simeon; 4,600 from Levi, including Jehoiada, who was a leader from Aaron's descendants, and his 3,700 men, as well as Zadok, who was a brave soldier, and 22 of his relatives, who were also officers; 3,000 from Benjamin, because this was Saul's own tribe and most of the men had remained loyal to him; 20,800 from Ephraim, who were not only brave, but also famous in their clans; 18,000 from West Manasseh, who had been chosen to help make David king; 200 leaders from Issachar, along with troops under their command—these leaders knew the right time to do what needed to be done; 50,000 from Zebulun, who were not only loyal, but also trained to use any weapon; 1,000 officers from Naphtali and 37,000 soldiers armed with shields and spears; 28,600 from Dan; 40,000 from Asher; and 120,000 from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, who were armed with all kinds of weapons.
38All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing. 39The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them. 40Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil.
Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_text:
1Nidoama de ale jan jam Deevid jigi Ziklag po ase Kis nidoabinni Sɔɔl ale jam yiak wa a basi la. Ba jam maa gum ka tugurik nyama po baai ale jam maari wa kpaliŋ ka po la. 2Ba jam ta ka tima a baga a tɔŋ peema ale a nak visiŋ tana ale ba juga yaase ba gala nisaŋa, ba jam ka Sɔɔl nuruba a nyini Benjamin dɔkku buuni po.
3Ayiezer a jam le ba niŋdeerɔ, Joas a jam maa boro kama. Ayiezer ale Joas jam ka Sɛmaaya nidoabilisa, baai ale nyini Gibea tɛŋka la. Azmavet nidoabilisaŋa Jeziel ale Pelet a jam maa boro kama. Berakaya ale Anatot denɔwa Jeyu jam gum du kama. 4Ismaiya ale nyini Gibeon tɛŋka la a jam boro, wa jam ka nuruba Pisitawa po wanyi. Chekki wa jam le nuruba Pisitawa niŋdeerɔ. Jeremaya ale Jayaziel ale Joyanan ale Jozabad ale nyini Gederat tɛŋka la a jam boro kama. 5Baai ale jam maa boro la ale Eluzai ale Jerimot ale Bealia ale Sɛmariya. Sefatia ale nyini Yaruf la a jam boro kama. 6Koora demma Elkana ale Issia ale Azarel ale Joezer ale Jasobeam a jam maa boro kama. 7Gedor denɔwa Jeroyam nidoabilisaŋa Joela ale Zebadia mɛ jam boro kama.
8Gad demma gela ale jam ga gum Deevid po wa pagrimu ale jam bo juijui la sagni po. Ba jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔ baai ale toa la, a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ ale baga a yik kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsinta ale gbatta. Ba nimbidaasaŋa jam a nye ase ka gbeŋma nimbidaasaŋa la, a korisi ase walisa ale bo guuta zuima la.
9Ezer a jam le ba kpagi ate Obadia a pasaŋ ate Eliab pasaŋ 10ate Mismanna nye bunaansi ate Jeremaya a chim bunu nyɔnɔ. 11Buyuebiwa po ka Attai buyopɔiwa a chim Eliel ate 12Joyanan a nye naaniŋ. Neokku jam ka Elzabad ate 13Jeremaya a nye pi ate pi ale bunyiwa a chim Makbannai.
14Gad dɔkku demma de jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba kpaga, waai ale wobsa ba po la a tu chaab ale ka nuruba kook ate pagrɔ a tu chaab ale nuruba tusidi. 15Ku abe jam ka bala ale lo Jodan benni a jueli piilimka chiika po ase benni ale jam mobi pinpantaŋa la, a basi ate waai meena jam bo vaasaŋa po kori ale yeniŋ geŋsa la a yiti chali la.
16Benjamin dɔkku dem gela ale Juda dɔkku dem gela mɛ a jan jam Deevid jigi wa pagrimu jigini. 17Deevid yaa nyini peelim wa tu ba ale weeni ba ayen, <<Ase ni dan jam mi jigi ale suiyɔgni, ayen ni maari mu, mi gomsi kama ayen, <<Ni nye nɔiyeŋ ale mu. Alege ni dan jam kama ayen ni bobri mi wie a te mi dachaasaŋa alege ate mi an nye ni wari ya, ti koma Wenni abe nya a bo ni buusa.>>
18Wen Chiika yaa jam Amasai jigi waai ale ka kpagi nuruba Pisita zuk la ate wa weeni ayen, <<Deevid, tama ka fi nuruba. Tama a bo ale ka fi, Jese nidoabili yaa! Suiyɔgni, suiyɔgni a jam fi jigi, abe suiyɔgni a cheŋ baai ale a maari fi la jigi, ate fi Wenni ale maari fu.>> Dila Deevid yaa tuesi ba a basi ate ba chim wa tugurik tommu niŋdeerɔba.
19Manasa dɔkku demma gela ale jam ga gum Deevid po diipo ate wa ale Filistia demma le cheŋ ba nye kpaliŋ ale Sɔɔl la. Wa ale wa nuruma an jam maari Filistia demma dii nyiŋla, ba ale jam wom nyini chaab jigi la, ba niŋdeerɔma a jam zɛri kama. Ba weeni ayen, <<Ti nyuvooŋa a bo ka wari po ase wa a nin ŋman cheŋ wa kpagni Sɔɔl jigi.>> 20Ase Deevid ale jam cheŋ Ziklag la, Manasa nidoama de ale jam ga gum Deevid po la. Bala abe le Adnaa ale Jozabad ale Jediael ale Maakil ale Jozabad ale Eliyu ale Zilletai. Ba jam a nya ka tugurik tom tusa zuk Manasa dɔkku buuni po. 21Ba jam maari Deevid kama ate wa kpaliŋ ale baai ale jam boro a vari nuruma la, diila ba meena jam ka kpaliŋ nyeerɔ tuasa, ate ba jam chim kpaga wa tugurik tommu zuk. 22Dai meena ale a taam la nidoaba ale jam a maari Deevid ate ku paari diipo ate wa ta tugurik tom ate bu zuak ase Wen tugurik tommu la.
23Nidoama de nɔi ale jam ka dii a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ a jam Deevid jigi Yebron po ayen ba tulim Sɔɔl naamu a te Deevid ase Naawen ale weeni la. 24Juda dɔkku nuruma ale jam a ji kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsintaŋa ale gbattaŋa la jam ka tusa ŋayuebi ale kobsinaaniŋ (6,800) a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ. 25Simeyon dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale gomsi a magsi kpaliŋ la jam ka tusa ŋayopɔi ale kook (7,100). 26Livai dɔkku nidoama jam ka tusa ŋanaansi ale kobsiyuebi (4,600), 27a gum chaab ale Jeyoiada ale ka Aaron dɔkdemma niŋdeerɔ la ale nidoaba tusa ŋata ale kobsiyopɔi (3,700) ale 28Zadok tugurik tɔŋdɔ paalik tuak ale kpaga pisiye ale ŋaye a nyini wa dɔkdemma po. 29Benjamin dɔkku demma, Sɔɔl dek nuruma jam ka tusa ŋata (3,000), ba yega a jam bo ale ka Sɔɔl wa vaaŋa po alege yɔgyɔgla de ba va ka Deevid. 30Ɛfraim dɔkku nidoama, tugurik tɔŋdɔ tuasa, a ta yuei ba yezuimaŋa po la jam ka tusa pisiye ale kobsinaaniŋ (20,800). 31Manasa dɔkku genni nidoama ate ba te ba yueŋa ayen ba jam bobi Deevid naab la jam ka tusa pi ale naaniŋ (18,000). 32Isaka dɔkku, baai ale seba diipo ale magsi ba nye kpaliŋ ale seba Izirali demma ale ba nye diila jam ka kpaga kobsiye (200) a nya badek nuruma zuk. 33Zebulun dɔkku nidoama tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale nye kpaliŋ nya a gomsi magsi kpaliŋ ale kpaliŋ jaab meena, ayen ba maari Deevid ale popola yena la, jam ka tusa pisinu (50,000). 34Nafitali dɔkku kpaŋŋa jam ka tusidi a gum chaab ale nidoa baai ale a ji kpaliŋ ŋanchɔgsintaŋa ale gbattaŋa la jam ka tusa pisita ale ŋayopɔi (37,000). 35Dan dɔkku nidoama ale jam gomsi magsi kpaliŋ la jam ka tusa pisiye ale naaniŋ ale kobsiyuebi (28,600). 36Asɛ dɔkku tugurik tɔŋdɔma ale nye kpaliŋ a nya, gomsi magsi kpaliŋ la jam ka tusa pisinaansi (40,000). 37A nyini Jodan beni kori geŋsa, Aruben dɔkku ale Gad dɔkku ale Manasa dɔkku ale kpesi badek ale kpaliŋ ale kpaliŋ jaab meena la, jam ka tusa kook ale pisiye (120,000).
38Bade meena jam ka tugurik tɔŋdɔba a pai badek te ayen ba tom. Ba jam Yebron tɛŋka po kama a gomsi paari ayen ba bobi Deevid Naab Izirali meena zuk. Izirali dem mbala meena mɛ a jam ta ka popola yena ayen ba bobi Deevid naab. 39Nidoama meena a jam bo ale Deevid ka daa ŋata a dɛ ale a nyu, diila ba dɔkdemma a jam te ba ka ŋandiinta. 40Ba nuruma ale bo Isaka ale Zebulun ale Nafitali diinaŋa la a jam ji ka ŋandiinta ale bonsa ale laalaakomiba ale wusum bonsa ale lalisa a jam te ba. Ba jam te ba ka ŋandiinta nna yegayega tila ale zom ale kiŋkama maasa ale yɔna maasa ale daam ale kpaam ale niiga ale piisa, diila masim ale jam bo Izirali tɛŋka.

english_text:
David Moves the Sacred Chest to Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 6.1-12a)
1Some time later, David talked with his army commanders, 2-3and then announced to the people of Israel:
While Saul was king, the sacred chest was ignored. But now it's time to bring the chest to Jerusalem. We will invite everyone in Israel to come here, including the priests and the Levites in the towns surrounded by pastureland. But we will do these things only if you agree, and if the Lord our God wants us to.
4The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
5David gathered everyone from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo-Hamath in the north. 6 Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
7The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart, 8while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
9But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling. 10The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
11David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
12David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?” 13So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
14 The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_text:
1Deevid yaa jam biisi ale wa tugurik tommu kpaŋŋa, kpaga ŋaai ale a nya tusa zuk la ale kpaga ŋaai ale a nya kobsa zuk la. 2Wa yaa jam weeni Izirali tigsuŋku meena ayen, <<Ase ku dan chim wamaŋ a te ni ase ku dan ka Naawen ti Wenni yaalika, basi ate ti tom a weeni ate ku cheŋ niŋniŋŋa a waaŋ paari ti suataŋa meena jigi Izirali tɛŋka po meena, ale kaabteerɔma ale Livaima baai ale bo ale ba ba tɛŋsaŋa po la ale wuuk tɛŋsaŋa la, ate ba jam a gum ti po. 3Ni basi ate ti ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a ŋman jam ti jigi, ale tama an bek di wari diipo ate Sɔɔl a dɛ naam la.>> 4Tigsuŋku meena yaa siak ayen ba nye kude, dii nyiŋla ku jam magsi kama a te nuruma meena.
5Dila nyiŋ Deevid yaa tigsi Izirali demma meena, a nyini Siyor Benaŋka ale bo Ejipiti po la ga paari Yamat tɛŋka ayen ba ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Kiriat Jearim a jam. 6Deevid ale Izirali demma meena yaa cheŋ Baalaya ale bo Juda la Kiriat Jearim ale la ayen ba ta Wen dii ale ka Naawen la nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini dula a jam, dii ale jam bo ŋanvutaŋa suŋsuŋ la dakanni ate ba pai wa Yuenni a wi di la.
7Ba jam ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Abinadab yenni ale ka toroko paalik, ate Uzzaya ale Ayio a nya di zuk. 8Deevid ale Izirali demma meena a jam boro a naŋ kama ale ba pagrim meena Wen niŋ ale yiila ale kpanta ale bagansa ale sinyaara ale dalinkinkeŋsa ale damunsa.
9Ase ba ale jam paari Kidon ŋanta fɔbika jigini la, Uzzaya yaa laari wa nisaŋa ayen wa yik dakanni, dii nyiŋla lalisaŋa nyiŋsa ale jam a gɔk. 10Naawen sui yaa jam puuri ale Uzzaya, ate wa ko wa dii nyiŋla wa jam tiri dakanni kama ale nisa. Wa jam kpi ka dula Wen niŋ.
11Deevid sui yaa jam puuri dii nyiŋla Naawen suipuurumu ale jan jam Uzzaya zuk la, a ta jam paari jinla danni dula yuei ale Perezi Uzzaya.
12Deevid yaa jam yɔgsa ale Wen dai dila danni a bek ayen, <<Mi ale nye ka sɛ a ta Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam m jigi yaa?>> 13Wa an jam te Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a va wa a cheŋ Deevid Tɛŋka po. Wa goanti ta di a cheŋ ka Gitti denɔwa Obed Edom yenni. 14Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam wari bo ka Obed Edom dɔkdemma jigi wa yenni po a paari chiisa sita ate Naawen a niak wa yenni meena ale jabuui meena ate wa ta la.

english_text:
David's Palace in Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 5.11-16)
1King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace. 2David now knew that the Lord had made him a powerful king of Israel for the good of his people.
3After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters. 4-7His children born there were Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
David Defeats the Philistines
(2 Samuel 5.17-25)
8When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle. 9The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
10David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?”
The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
11David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.” 12Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
13Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley. 14David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are. 15Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
16David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
17From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_text:
1Taaya naawa Yiram yaa jam tom nuruba naab Deevid jigi ale nyunyoŋta, ale baai ale seba tana yie seka la ale seba daata nakka la ayen ba ga sɛ naab yeri a te wa. 2Deevid a jam seba kama ayen Naawen bobi wa ka naab Izirali zuk ate wa naamu yuei a yiti wa nuruma Izirali demma nyiŋ.
3Jerusalem po Deevid a jam faari ka nipok boari a biak nidoabilisa ale lieba nna yegayega. 4Wa ale jam biak baai dula la yueŋa ale Sammua ale Sobab ale Natan ale Solomon 5ale Ibyar ale Elisua ale Elpelet ale 6Noga ale Nefeg ale Jafia ale 7Elisama ale Beeliada ale Elifelet.
8Ase Filistia demma ale ga wom ayen Deevid a chim naab Izirali demma meena zuk la, ba yaa jam nyini a gisi wa, alege Deevid a jam wom ku wari kama a nyini ayen wa tu ba. 9Filistia demma a jam bo ka Arefaim Viaka po. 10Deevid yaa bek Wen ayen, <<M ga siti Filistia demma? Fi ale pai ba a te mu?>> Ate Naawen a tulisi wa ayen, <<Cheŋ, mi ale pai ba a te fu.>>
11Deevid ale wa nidoama yaa cheŋ Baal Perazim, dula jigini wa jam nya pagrim ba zuk. Wa weeni ayen, <<Ase nyiam ale mobi a nyini diila, Wen sui a puuri ale mi dachaasaŋa ate mi a siti ba.>> Dila nyiŋ ate dula yuei a chim Baal Perazim la. 12Filistia demma a jam banti ba wenaŋa kama dula jigini, ate Deevid a weeni ayen ba ju ŋa ale bolim.
13Filistia demma a ŋman ga bo viaka po. 14Dila Deevid yaa bek Wen ŋmana ate Wen a tulisi wa ayen kan deri a cheŋ yɔrr, cheŋ a gilim ba a siti ba a nyini puuta tiimu niŋka. 15Ase fi dan ga wom santiri nuemka puuta tiimu zukparuk, nyini a cheŋ kpaliŋka jigini, dii nyiŋla, dila kiri ale Wen a dɛ ka fi niŋ wa ko Filistia tugurik tommu.>> 16Deevid a jam nye ka dii ate Wen a weeni wa la, ba jam ko Filistia tugurik tommu kama a nyini Gibeon a ta ga paari Gezer tɛŋka.
17Deevid yuei a jam yiti kama tɛŋ meena po, ate Naawen a nye ate tɛŋsa meena a chali wa yɔgsum.

english_text:
David Gets Ready To Bring the Sacred Chest to Jerusalem
1David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept. 2 He said, “Only Levites will be allowed to carry the chest, because the Lord has chosen them to do that work and to serve him forever.”
3Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it. 4He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were: 5Uriel, the leader of the Kohath clan, and 120 of his relatives; 6Asaiah, the leader of the Merari clan, and 220 of his relatives; 7Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and 130 of his relatives; 8Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and 200 of his relatives; 9Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and 80 of his relatives; and 10Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with 112 of his relatives.
11David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar. 12He said to them, “You are the leaders of the clans in the Levi tribe. You and your relatives must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean and acceptable to the Lord. Then you may carry the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord God of Israel and bring it to the place I have prepared for it. 13The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
14The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest 15 on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
16David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals. 17-21The men chosen to play the cymbals were Heman the son of Joel, his relative Asaph the son of Berechiah, and Ethan the son of Kushaiah from the Merari clan. Some of their assistants played the smaller harps: they were Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah. Others played the larger harps: they were Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Azaziah, and two of the temple guards, Obed-Edom and Jeiel.
22Chenaniah was chosen to be the music director, because he was a skilled musician.
23-24Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah.
Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer.
The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 6.12-22)
25David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest. 26God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
27David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth. 28While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
29Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_text:
1Deevid ale jam sɛ yee a te wadek tɛŋka po la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Deevid a jam gomsi ka jigi a magsi Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale ti viuk a magsi di. 2Deevid a yaa weeni ayen, <<Ka Livaima nyiini ale ba a ji Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni, dii nyiŋla Naawen ale lueri ba ayen ba a ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni abe ba a tom a te wa taam wuu.>>
3Deevid yaa jam tigsi Izirali demma meena Jerusalem po ayen wa ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam juijui ate wa gomsi a magsi di la po. 4Wa jam wi ka Aaron ŋaaŋbisaŋa ale Livaima ate ba jam jigi yeŋ.
5A nyini Koyat ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, jam ka Uriel ale niŋdeerɔ ale suata kook ale pisiye. 6A nyini Merari ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Asaiya jam le niŋdeerɔ ale suata kobsiye ale pisiye. 7A nyini Gerson ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Joel jam le ba niŋdeerɔ ale suata kook ale pisita. 8A nyini Elizafan ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Sɛmaiya a jam le ba niŋdeerɔ ale suata kobsiye. 9A nyini Yebron ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Eliel jam le niŋdeerɔ ale suata pinaanuŋ. 10A nyini Uzziel ŋaaŋbisaŋa po, Amminadab jam le niŋdeerɔ ale suata kook ale pi ale baye.
11Deevid yaa jam wi kaabteerɔma Zadok ale Abiata ale Livaima Uriel ale Asaiya ale Joel ale Sɛmaiya ale Eliel ale Amminadab ayen ba jam. 12Wa jam weeni ba ayen, <<Nama ale yie nyam Livaima dɔkdemma po, nama ale ni Livai chaama a magsi ka ni gomsi nidek a ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni, Izirali Wenni a jam juijui ate mi a gomsi magsi di la. 13Ku be jam ka nama Livaima ale kan jam ta di a jam piilimka po la nyiŋ ale soa ate Naawen ti Wenni sui a jam puuri ale ti. Ti an jam bek wa a wom dii ate ti le nye a ta va wa ale weeni diila.>> 14Kaabteerɔma yaa gomsi badek ayen ba ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni, Izirali Wenni a jam. 15Ate Livaima yaa ji Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale daata ba maŋkpalaŋa zuk ase Moosis ale jam weeni dii a ta va Naawen wanni la.
16Deevid yaa jam weeni Livaima niŋdeerɔma ayen ba lueri ba suataŋa ase yi lendisa la ale bagansa ale kpanta ale dalinkinkeŋsa a lenni mariŋka yiila.
17Livaima yaa lueri Joel nidoabinni Yeman, a nyini ba suataŋa po ka Berekiya nidoabinni Asaf ate ba lueri, a nyini ba suataŋa Merari kabini po ka Kusaiya nidoabinni Etan ate ba lueri. 18A gum ba po ka ba suata ti chaama ale jam ta kpaŋta la. Bala ale Zakaria ale Jaaziel ale Sɛmiramot ale Jeyiel ale Unni ale Eliab ale Benaya ale Maaseiya ale Mattitia ale Elifeleyu ale Mikneiya ale Obed Edom ale Jeiel, nansuiŋ limisidɔma.
19Yi lendisaŋa Yeman ale Asaf ale Etan ale ba kutuk mɔnuŋ dalinkinkeŋsaŋa. 20Zakaria ale Aziel ale Sɛmiramot ale Jeyiel ale Unni ale Eliab ale Maaseiya ale Benaya ale ba nak baganisaŋa a ta va chaab ale alamot, 21ate Mattitia ale Elifeleu ale Mikneiya ale Obed Edom ale Jeiel ale Azaziya ale jam ayen ba a nak kpantaŋa a sak a ta va chaab ale seminit. 22Kenania Livaima kpagni ale jam a nya yiilaŋa zuk, wa tuini jam le la dii nyiŋla wa ale jam kperi ale yiila lennika.
23Berekiya ale Elkana ale jam ayen ba a nya dakanni nansuiŋku. 24Sebania ale Josafat ale Netanel ale Amasai ale Zakaria ale Benaya ale Ɛlieza kaabteerɔwa ale jam ayen ba a peeri damunsaŋa Wen nɔiyeŋka dakanni niŋ. Obed Edom ale Jeyia mɛ a jam maari a nya ka dakanni nansuiŋku.
25Dila nyiŋ Deevid ale Izirali nisɔmma ale tugurik tɔŋdɔ kpaŋŋa ale a nya tusa zuk la yaa jam cheŋ ayen ba ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a nyini Obed Edom yenni a jam ale mariŋka. 26Dii nyiŋla wen jam maari Livaima baai ale jam ji Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni la kama, lalisa siyopɔi ale padaasa siyopɔi ate ba jam pa nye kaabka. 27Deevid a jam jo ka garuk geli ase Livaima meena baai ale jam ji dakanni la, ase yi lendisaŋa ale Kenania waai ale jam a nya yi lendisaŋa zuk la meena ale jam jo ba gattaŋa diila. 28Izirali demma meena yaa jam ta Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni a jam a nuem ale padaasa nyiila ale damunsa ale dalinkinkeŋsa ale baganiŋsa ale kpanta nakka.
29Ase Naawen nɔiyeŋka dakanni ale jam a jo Deevid Tɛŋka po la, Sɔɔl liewa Michal yaa jam liisi va tuokparuk a nya. Ase wa ale nya ale naab Deevid a gɔk a naŋ diila wa sui yaa puuri.

english_text:
1They put the sacred chest inside the tent that David had set up for it, then they offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. 2After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord 3and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
