Daamu yaa le nueri la, Yeezu mawa yaa ga weeni wa ayen daamu a nueri kama. 4Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Kan weeni mu dii ate mi ayen m nye la, dii nyiŋla diipo ate mi a yaali ayen m nye wari la an diem paari ya.>> 5Wa mawa yaa weeni yenni tomteerɔma ayen, <<Wa dan weeni ayen ni nye wari, ni nye.>> 6Samɔniŋ kpieŋsa siyuebi ale jam bo yenni po. Samɔniŋ kanyi a jam a su ase ka leŋsa pisiye yaase pisita nyiam la. Juuma a nyiem a dan boro a gomsi ayen ba dɛ ŋandiinta, ba a ŋari nyiam a nyo samɔnsaŋa de po a nye ŋiak wanni ale nye ate ba a nye cheri. 7Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni ŋari nyiam a sueri samɔnsaŋa.>> Ba yaa ŋari a sueri, 8wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni ŋari bu a ta ga te waai ale ka kpagni a nya nichamma zuk la.>> Ba yaa ŋari nyiamu a ta ga te wa. 9Kpagni ale lam nyiamu ale tagri a chim daamu a nya la, wa yaa zɛ bu le nyini ka juijui la, alege ka yenni tomteerɔma baai ale ŋari a ta ga te wa la, nyiini ale seba bu le nyini juijui la. Kpagni a yaa wi nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa a weeni wa ayen, 10<<Ba nyiem dɛ niŋ a chari ka damaŋka, ba ale nyu chak la ŋaaŋnyiŋ, ba yaa chari buui ale kan daa daam dek la, alege fi pai damaŋka ate bu paari yɔgyɔgla de.>> 11Yeezu a piilim tom wakperikaliika de ase daana la Kena tɛŋka ate ka bo Galili po la, a sak wa zulaŋa ate wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a ta siaka ale wa.
12Nipok fiaka diintaŋa ale jam taam la, Yeezu ale wa mawa ale wa yuama ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a yaa basi dula jigini ale ge cheŋ Kapernaum a yaa bo dula daa maga.
13Gaambasika Tigini a jam moata kama ate Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a yaa cheŋ Jerusalem tɛŋka. 14Ba yaa ga jo Wen yenni po, a nya nuruba a ta niiga ale piisa ale nangbaŋsa a da. Baai mɛ jam ta ligra a tagri. 15Yeezu yaa yaali miisa a melim chaab ase fiŋ la a yiak niiŋa ale piisaŋa ate ŋa nyini Wen yenni po, ale yik baai ale a tagri ligra la ligraŋa a kpiiri basi, ale tulim ba ŋanzaanitaŋa a kpib. 16Wa yaa weeni baai ale ta nangbaŋsaŋa a da la ayen, <<Ni pai ŋantaŋa de meena dela a ta nyini. Ni kan basi ate m Kowa yenni a chim geruŋ jigi ya.>> 17Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa teeri dii ate ba jam ŋmarisi ayen, <<Fi yenni wie nyiini ale bo m suinum po a dɛ nna ase bolim la.>> (Yiila 69:9) 18Juuma yaa jam weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Fi ta ka boan daana ayen fi nye a sak fi pagrimu tuimaŋa de meena po?>> 19Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni be nak yenni de a lɔnsi tɛŋ ate mi a ŋman se di a nueri daa ŋata po.>> 20Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Tama nuruma a pai ka bena pisinaansi ale ŋayuebi a se di. Fi ale baga a pai daa ŋata a ŋman se di a nueri?>> 21Alege yenni ate Yeezu jam a biisi la a magsi chaab ale ka wadek nyiŋka. 22Yeezu ale jam a kpi ate Wen a basi ate wa yiti kum po la, wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a yaa jam teeri dii ate wa weeni la. Ba yaa jam ta siaka ale Yeezu ale weeni ba diila, ale ba le ŋmarisi wa wie Wen gbaŋka po diila ka wensie.
23Yeezu ale jam boro a dɛ Gaambasika Tigini Jerusalem tɛŋka po la, nuruba yegayega a jam nya wa wakperikaliik sii ate wa jam tom ase daana la, a yaa ta siaka ale wa. 24Alege Yeezu an jam a pai wadek a te ba. 25Dii nyiŋla wa jam seba nuru meena kama, wa an jam a yaali waai weeni nurubiik ale ka dii la a sak wa, wadek a seba dii ale bo nuru po la kama.

english_text:
Jesus and Nicodemus
1There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader. 2One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
3Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
4Nicodemus asked, “How can a grown man ever be born a second time?”
5Jesus answered:
I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit. 6Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God. 7Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above. 8Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
9“How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
10Jesus replied:
How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things? 11I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say. 12 If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
13 No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there. 14 And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert. 15Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
16God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die. 17God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them! 18No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
19The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light. 20People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done. 21But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do.
Jesus and John the Baptist
22Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
23-24 John had not yet been put in jail. He was at Aenon near Salim, where there was a lot of water, and people were coming there for John to baptize them.
25John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing. 26They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
27John replied:
No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it. 28 You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
29At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad. 30Jesus must become more important, while I become less important.
The One Who Comes from Heaven
31God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others. 32He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him. 33But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful. 34The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
35 The Father loves the Son and has given him everything. 36Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_text:
1Nuru wanyi ale jam boro. Wa yuei jam le Nikodimusi. Wa jam ka Juuma nisɔmma po wanyi ale Farisiima po wanyi. 2Yɔk kunyi po ate nuruwa de yaa cheŋ Yeezu jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<M Sagrɔ, tama seba fi ka sagrɔ waai ate Wen a tom fu. Nuru an baga a nye wakperikaliik sii ate fi a tom ase daana la, ka Wen a nin bo ale wa.>> 3Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni fu ayen nuru an baga a jo Wen naamu po, ka ba nin pilim biak wa.>>
4Nikodimusi yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ba ale nye ka sɛ a pilim biak nuru waai ale chim ya? Wa le ŋman baga a jo wa mawa ponni po ate ba a biak wa buye?>> 5Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni fu ayen nuru an baga a jo Wen naamu po, ka ba nin biak wa ale nyiam ale pilim biak wa ale Wen Chiika. 6Waai ate ba biak nyiŋ lammu po la, ka nyiŋ lam, waai ate ba biak Chiika po la ka chiik. 7Kan te ku cha fu mi ale weeni fu ayen, <Ka ba nin pilim biak fu la.> 8Vioku a fuk a cheŋ ka juijui meena ate ku a yaali la, ate fi mɛ a wom ku fukka, alege fi zɛ ku le nyini juijui la yaase ku ale a cheŋ juijui la. Ku abe ka dila ale waai meena ate Wen Chiika a biak la.>>
9Nikodimusi yaa bek wa ayen, <<Nya kude ale nye ka sɛ a nye?>> 10Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ka sagrɔ kpioŋ a bo Izirali tɛŋka alege an baga a miŋ mi ale weeni fu diila kiri ya? 11Wensie ate mi a weeni fu ayen ti a biisi ka wie ŋaai ate ti seba ŋa la, ale a weeni wie ŋaai ate ti nya ŋa la, alege ni waai a kan siak tama wieŋa. 12Ni ka siaka ale mi ase m nin weeni tɛŋka de zuk wie, ni abe ni nye ka sɛ a ta siaka ale mi ase m nin weeni wenŋmazuk wie? 13Nuru karo a jueli wenŋmazuwa ka Mi Saalɔbiika ale nyini wenŋmazuk a jam tɛŋzuk de. 14Ase Moosis ale jam mɛ waamu a yik diok woŋku nyiŋ a zak zaani sagni po la, dila dek ate ba le yik Mi Saalɔbiika a kpi jabarimu nyiŋ a zak zaani. 15Ate waai meena ale a ta siaka ale mi la ale nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka.
16<<Wen a yaali tɛŋzuk de demma ka nna yegayega ate wa tom wa bi yeŋka ba jigi, ayen baai ale ta siaka ale wa la a kan kpi alege ba le nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. 17Wen an tom wa Nidoabinni ayen wa jam kaasi tɛŋzuk de demma, alege wa jam kama ayen wa vari ba a basi. 18Baai ale ta siaka ale Wen Nidoabinni la, Wen a kan bo ba buusa. Baai ale kan ta siaka ale wa Nidoabinni la, Wen a poom bo ba buusa kama, dii nyiŋla ba an ta siaka ale wa bi yeŋka. 19Buusaŋa abe le nna, ayen Bolimu a jam tɛŋzuk de kama, ate nurubiik a yaali legini a gaam Bolimu, dii la ba nyeelaŋa jam ka biem nyeela. 20Ba seba ayen ba dan bo Bolimu nyaka jigini a tom ba wabaataŋa, waai meena ale nya dii ate ba a nye la kama. Ka dila ale soa ate ba kan yaali ayen ba moata Bolimu jigini. 21Alege baai ale a tom dii ale ka wensie la, bala a kan chali bolimu jigini boka. Ba a tom ba tuimaŋa ate ŋa a sak kama ayen ba a tom ka dii ate Wen a yaali la.>>
22Kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa basi dula jigini ale ge cheŋ Judia. Ba jam bo dula ka daa maga dega a te nuruba soka. 23Jɔɔn mɛ a jam a te nuruba soka Enon tɛŋka po, a moata Salim tɛŋka, dii nyiŋla nyiamu a jam zuak kama dula jigini. Nuruba yaa jam wa jigi ate wa te ba soka. 24Kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ ale ba yik Jɔɔn a lik la.
25Dai yeŋ po ate Juuma wanyi a yaa jam Jɔɔn ŋaaŋviirɔma jigi a ta nanpaga ale ba soka teka nyiŋ. 26Ba yaa jam Jɔɔn jigi a weeni wa ayen, <<Ti Sagrɔ, nuru waai ale poom a bo ale ti Jodan Benni kauk kunkula ale dii ate fi poom a weeni wa wie a sak ti la, yɔgyɔgla de wa yaa a te ka nuruba soka ate waai meena a cheŋ wa jigi.>> 27Jɔɔn yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nuru an baga a lueri wari wa dega, ka Wen a nin te wa. 28Nama teeri ayen mi a poom weeni ni ayen, <Daa mi ale Kirisitawa.> Wen a tom mi ate mi dɛ wa niŋ a jam ayen m gomsi suiku a magsi a te Wa. 29Nuru waai a dan faari nipok, ka wala dek ale soa wa. Mi a nye ase ka nipok fiaka nyɔnɔwa doa la. Mi sui a peenti kama ayen mi moata wa ale a wom wa lueluku. Nuruma a dan basi mi ale ge cheŋ Yeezu jigi ayen wa te ba soka, kula a peenti mi sui ka nna yegayega a gaam ku le poom ka diila. 30Ku magsi kama ayen wala a jueli ŋmai abe mi a bo tɛŋ.>>
31Waai ale nyini wenŋmazuk la a gaam waai meena kama. Waai ale nyini tɛŋzuk de la, ka tɛŋzuk de nuru ale a biisi tɛŋzuk de wie, alege waai ale nyini wenŋmazuk la a gaam waai meena kama. 32Wa a weeni ka wie ŋaai ate wa nya ale wom la alege waai a ka siaka ale ŋa. 33Alege waai ale ta siaka ale wa wieŋa la a sak kama ayen Wen ka wensie nyɔnɔ. 34Waai ate Wen tom la a biisi ka Wen wieŋa, dii nyiŋla Wen a basi ate wa Chiika a bo ale wa kama. 35Kowa a yaali wa Nidoabinni kama ate wa pai jaabuuri meena pagrim a te wa. 36Waai meena ale ta siaka ale wa Nidoabinni la a nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la kama. Waai meena mɛ ale kan ta siaka ale wa ale kan va wa nɔi la, a kan nya nyuvuri dila, alege Wen suipuurumu ale jam wa zuk.>>

english_text:
1Jesus knew that the Pharisees had heard that he was winning and baptizing more followers than John was. 2But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself.
Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
3Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again. 4This time he had to go through Samaria, 5 and on his way he came to the town of Sychar. It was near the field that Jacob had long ago given to his son Joseph. 6-8The well that Jacob had dug was still there, and Jesus sat down beside it because he was tired from traveling. It was noon, and after Jesus' disciples had gone into town to buy some food, a Samaritan woman came to draw water from the well.
Jesus asked her, “Would you please give me a drink of water?”
9 “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
10Jesus answered, “You don't know what God wants to give you, and you don't know who is asking you for a drink. If you did, you would ask me for the water that gives life.”
11“Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water? 12Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
13Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will get thirsty again. 14But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
15The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
16Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
17-18The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.”
“That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
19The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet. 20My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
21Jesus said to her:
Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem. 22You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world. 23But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him. 24God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
25The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
26“I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
27The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
28The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people, 29“Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?” 30Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
31While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
32But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
33His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
34Jesus said:
My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do. 35You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
36Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together. 37So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.” 38I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
39A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.” 40They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
41Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say. 42They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!”
Jesus Heals an Official's Son
(Matthew 8.5-13; Luke 7.1-10)
43-44 Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left 45 and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
46 While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick. 47And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
48Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
49The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
50Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
51Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!” 52He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
53The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
54This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_text:
1Farisiima ale jam wom ayen nuruba yegayega a va Yeezu ŋaaŋ ate wa a te ba soka a gaam Jɔɔn la, 2daa Yeezu dek ale jam a te nuruma soka, alege ka wa ŋaaŋviirɔma. 3Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita jam basi Judia ale ŋmani a cheŋ Galili. 4Yeezu a jam va ka Samaria a cheŋ Galili. 5Ba yaa jam paari Samaria tɛŋ kanyi ate ba a wi ayen Saika, moata talim buui ate Jekob a pai te wa nidoabinni Josefi la. 6Vili dii ate Jekob a jam tu la a bo ka dula jigini. Yeezu ale jiak la wa yaa kali vinni tɛŋ a vuusi. Wenbinni a jam jueli ka wenzuk suŋsuŋ.
7Nipok yaa nyini Samaria a jam wa ŋari nyiam. Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Te mu nyiam ate m nyu.>> 8Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a jam cheŋ ka tɛŋ kpieŋka po ayen ba da ŋandiinta. 9Nipowa a yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ka Juu alege mi a chim Samaria tɛŋka nipok. Ka boa ate fi a juisi nyiam mi jigi ya?>> (Juuma a ka wari a nye ale Samaria demma.) 10Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ase fi dan seba Wen tiirimu kama ale waai ale a juisi nyiamu fi jigi la, fi ate le juisi nyiam wa jigi ate wa te fu nya buui ale a te nyuvuri la.>> 11Nipowa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M nyɔnɔ, fi ka jaŋarimmoa alege vinni mɛ limisa. Fi ale nya, nya bula ka be a te mi? 12Tama kokpieŋka, Jekob, ale tu vinni de dipo, ayen wa ale wa dɔkdemma ale wa duŋsaŋa a nya nyiam a nyu di po. Fi abe zuak a gaam ti kokpieŋka Jekob kama?>> 13Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Waai meena ale a nyu nyiam vinni de po la, nyanyuila ale ŋman yik wa. 14Waai meena ale a nyu nya buui ate mi a te wa la, nyanyuila a kan ŋman yik wa diipo diipo. Mi ale m te nya buui la ale kasim a buli kama a te wa nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.>>
15Nipowa yaa le ga wom dii ate Yeezu a weeni la, wa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M nyɔnɔ, be te mu fi nyiamu de ate nyanyuila a kan ŋman yik mu ate m ŋman jam dela a ŋari nyiamoa.>> 16Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Cheŋ a ga wi fi chorɔwa ate ni jam.>> 17Wa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi ka chora.>> Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ale weeni diila ka wensie. 18Fi yali ka nidoaba banu. Nidoa waai ate fi boro ale wa jinla la wala ka fi nɔŋ. Fi ale weeni mu diila ka wensie.>> 19Nipowa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M nyɔnɔ, fi ale a biisi diila a basi kama ate m miŋ ayen fi ka Wen biisiteerɔma po wanyi. 20Nya guuk kpioŋku de kuui ale za dela la. Ti kokpieŋsaŋa a puusi a te Wen ka kula zuk alege nama Juuma a weeni ti ayen ka Jerusalem tɛŋka ale Wen puusi teka jigi.>>
21Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nipowa, ta siaka ale mi ku danni a cheena ate nuruba a kan ŋman puusi Kowa guuku de zuk yaase Jerusalem tɛŋka po. 22Nama Samaria demma, ni sum zɛ waai dek ate ni puusi a te la. Tama Juuma a seba waai dek ate ti puusi a te la kama. Dii la varibasika a nyini ka Juuma jigi. 23Dai a cheena, di abe poom jam kama ayen, baai ale sum a puusi Wen la a puusi Kowa chiika po ale wensie, ka bala ale Kowa a gisi ayen ba a puusi wa. 24Wen ka chiik, baai ale a puusi wa la ku a fɛ ate ba puusi wa chiika po ale wensie.>> 25Nipowa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M seba ayen Waai Ate Wen A Lueri La a cheena kama waai ate ba a wi ayen Kirisitawa la. Wa dan jam, wa le sak ti wie meena.>> 26Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi ka wala waai ale a biisi ale fu la.>>
27Wa le diem boro a biisi la, wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa deri ŋman jam. Ba le nya Yeezu ale nipowa a za a biisi la, ku yaa deri cha ba, alege ba waai an jam bek wa ayen ka boa ate fi a biisi ale wa yaase jabuui wari ate ba a biisi la. 28Dula jigini nipowa yaa basi wa nyiamu liikka ale ŋmani cheŋ tɛŋka po a ga weeni nidoama ayen, 29<<Ni jam nya nuru ale weeni mi wie ŋaai meena ate mi nye la. Wala ale baga a chim Kirisitawa?>> 30Ba le wom dii ate wa weeni la, ba yaa deri nyini a cheŋ Yeezu jigi.
31Ase nipowa ale jam bo suiku po a kuli la, Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa saalim wa ayen, <<Ti Sagrɔ, ti a saalim fu ayen fi ŋoa ŋandiintaŋa a dɛ.>> 32Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi ta ka ŋandiinta m dɛ tii ate nama a zɛ la.>> 33Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Ka nuru yaa be le ta ŋandiinta a jam a te wa ale ge tama a zɛ yaa?>> 34Yeezu yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<Mi ŋandiintaŋa ale m nye waai ale tom mu la yaalika abe m nueri wa tuini. 35Nama a kan weeni kama ayen, <Ku diem tali ka chiisa sinaansi ate ti che?> Mi a weeni ni, ni lak ni ninaŋa a zak nya talimu po ŋantaŋa a bɛ magsi ka cheka. 36Nuru waai ale a che ŋantaŋa la a tuesi tutuna kama. Wa ale a tigsi ŋanbieŋa la a nye ase ka nuruba la, ate nuru bala a nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. Dila nyiŋ boridɔwa ale cheerɔwa sue ale peenti ale chaab. 37Juuma kpaŋŋa a nyiem ale kasim a weeni dii ayen, <Nuru wanyi ale a bori ate wanyi mɛ a che la,> ka wensie. 38Ka mi ale tom ni ayen ni cheŋ a ga che ŋantaŋa kadukka po. Nuru yonta ale bori ate nama ayen ni nya ba tuimaŋa nyuenta.>>
39Samaria tɛŋka nipowa ale ga weeni wa tɛŋka demma ayen ba jam nya nuru waai ale weeni wie ŋaai meena ate wa nye la, ba yegayega yaa jam ta siaka ale Yeezu. 40Ba yaa jam wa jigi a saalim wa ayen wa jam a bo ale ba. Yeezu yaa siak a wari ba jigi daa ŋaye. 41Wa le jam bo ale ba la, wa yaa sak ba Wen wie ate ba yegayega a ta siaka ale wa a gum baai ale poom a ta siaka la po. 42Ba yaa weeni nipowa ayen, <<Tama an ta siaka ale wa ka fi ale weeni ti diila nyiini nyiŋŋa, alege ka wa sakka nyiŋ ale soa ate ti ta siaka ale wa. Ti seba ayen ka wa a sum le tɛŋzuk de meena Varibasidɔwa.>>
43Daa maga ale jam taam la, Yeezu yaa basi dula jigini ale ge cheŋ Galili. 44Wadek a poom weeni kama ayen Wen biisiteerɔ dek tɛŋka demma a kan te wa zula. 45Ba ale paari Galili la nuruma a jam te wa tia kama dii nyiŋla ba cheŋ ga dɛ Gaambasika Tigini Jerusalem kama ale nya wie ŋaai meena ate wa tom la.
46Yeezu yaa ŋman cheŋ Kena tɛŋka ate ka bo Galili la. Ka dula jigini ate wa nye ate nyiamu a tagri a chim daamu la. Kpagi dinyi ale jam bo Kapernaum ate wa nidoabili a yuak. 47Wa le wom ayen Yeezu a basi Judia ale ŋman jam Galili la, wa yaa jam Yeezu jigi ayen wa saalim wa ate wa ga tebi wa nidoabinni waai ale moata kum la. 48Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nuruba a kan ta siaka ale mi, ka mi a nin tom wakperikaliisa ale daana ate ba nya.>> 49Kpagni yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, fi dan kan va mu a kuli nwuli, m biika ale kpi.>> 50Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Kuli yeri a ga nya fi nidoabinni ale wa ta nyiŋyɔgsa kama.>> Kpagni yaa deri ta siaka ale Yeezu ale weeni diila a yaa kuli. 51Wa le jam bo suiku po a kuli la, wa tomteerɔma gela yaa tu wa suiku niŋ a weeni wa ayen, <<Fi nidoabinni a ta nyiŋyɔgsa kama.>> 52Wa yaa bek ba ayen, <<Ka dimpo ate wa nya nyiŋyɔgsa?>> Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ka deemwa baŋ bunyi wentueŋ ate kazangbarimaŋa a basi wa.>> 53Biika kowa yaa deri teeri ayen ka diipo ate Yeezu a weeni wa ayen wa nidoabinni a nya nyiŋyɔgsa kama la. Wa yaa ga paari yeri a nya ale dii ate wa tomteerɔma a weeni wa la sum ka wensie. Wa le wa dɔkdemma meena a yaa ta siaka ale Yeezu dii ate wa nye la nyiŋ. 54Wakperikaliika de ase daana la ate Yeezu a tom saari buye wa le nyini Judia a jam Galili la.

english_text:
Jesus Heals a Sick Man
1Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival. 2In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
3-4Many sick, blind, lame, and paralyzed people were lying close to the pool.
5Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for 38 years. 6When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
7The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
8Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!” 9Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
10 When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
11But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
12They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?” 13But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
14Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.” 15The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him. 16They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
17But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.” 18 Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God.
The Son's Authority
19Jesus told the people:
I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do. 20The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed. 21Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
22The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone. 23The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him. 24I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
25I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live! 26The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son. 27And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
28Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man, 29 and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
30I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself.
Witnesses to Jesus
31If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth. 32But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true. 33 You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth. 34I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved. 35 John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
36But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
37 The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face. 38You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
39 You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me, 40but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
41I don't care about human praise, 42but I do know that none of you love God. 43I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own. 44How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
45Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you. 46Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me. 47But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_text:
1Daa maga ale jam a taam la, Yeezu yaa ŋman cheŋ Jerusalem tɛŋka ayen wa maa dɛ Juuma tigi dinyi.
2Beli gilini ale jam bo dula a moata tɛŋka nansuiŋtaŋa kunyi ate ba a wi ayen Piisa Nansuiŋ. Juuma a wi dula jigini ale badek tɛŋka biika ayen ka Betezata. Kusuŋta tinu ale jam gilim benni nɔnni. 3Yuarɔba yegayega ale jam dua kusuŋ tila po. Ba jam ka yeeba ale gbansa, ba gela mɛ naŋsa ale ba nisima a kpi. 4Naawen maarɔ nyiem ale jam siŋ nyiam po a choa. Wa dan choa jueli waai ale dɛ niŋ a siŋ nyiamu po la a nya nyiŋyɔgsa kama. 5Nuru wanyi a yaa maa boro ate yuammu a ta wa paari bena pisita ale naaniŋ. 6Yeezu ale nya wa la wa seba ayen tuemu a yik wa ate ku beni kama ate wa bek wa ayen, <<Fi a yaali fi nya nyiŋyɔgsa?>> 7Yuarɔwa yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M nyɔnɔ, nyiamu a nyiem dan choa, m ka nuru ate wa pai mu a ta ga a nyo bu po nwuli. M nyiem dan pii nyiŋ a yaali ayen m forisi a paari bu, nuru yoŋ a nyiem ale dɛ niŋ a paari du ale ge mu.>> 8Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Yiti a zaani abe fi kpamsi fi tiaka a cheŋ.>> 9Nuruwa yaa deri nya nyiŋyɔgsa a yiti zaani ale kpamsi wa tiaka a cheŋ. Dai dii danni ate nya kude a nye la a jam ka Juuma Vuusum Dai.
10Juuma yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ku a kisi kama ate fi ji fi tiaka tama Vuusum Danni po.>> 11Wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nuru waai ale tebi mu la ale weeni mu ayen m pai tiaka a cheŋ.>> 12Ba yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ka wana ale weeni fu ayen fi nye kude?>> 13Nuru waai ale nya nyiŋyɔgsaŋa la a jam zɛ Yeezu ale ka waai la, dii nyiŋla nuru boari ale jam bo dula ate Yeezu a moali nyini. 14Ku ŋaaŋnyiŋ Yeezu yaa ŋman nya wa Wen yenni po a weeni wa ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de fi yaa ta nyiŋyɔgsa kama. Be kan ŋman a tom tuimbaata. Fi dan ŋman tom tuimbaata, fi le nam a gaam ku le jam ka diila.>> 15Nuruwa yaa deri nyini a ga weeni Juuma ayen ka Yeezu ale tebi wa. 16Kude nyiŋ Juma yaa namsi Yeezu, diila wa nye kude ka Vuusum Danni. 17Alege Yeezu yaa tulisi ba ayen, <<M Kowa a diema tom kama ate mi mɛ a tom.>>
18Kude nyiŋ ate Juuma a jaa gisi ba ko wa la, dii nyiŋla daa Vuusum Danni nyiini ate wa kaasi alege wa jam a wi Wen ayen ka wadek Ko, a pai wadek a magsi chaab ale Wen.
19Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen Nidoabinni an baga a nye wadek wari ya. Dii meena ate m Kowa a tom la, mi mɛ a tom ka dila dekdega. 20Wa a yaali mu ale a sak mu dii meena ate wadek a tom la. M Kowa ale sak mu wa kpiema ate m tom ate ŋa zuak a gaam nya kude ate ku cha ni. 21Ase wa ale basi ate kpieba a yiti kum po la. Mi waai ale ka wa Nidoabili la, mi mɛ ale te baai ate mi a yaali la nyuvuri. 22Wa kan bo nuruba ba tuimbaata buusa. Wa pai dila a nyo ka mi nisima po. 23Ate waai meena a te mu zula ase ba ale a te m Kowa diila. Waai ale kan a te mi zula la, a kan te mi Kowa Wen dii ale tom mi la mɛ zula.
24<<Ni wom dii ate mi tara ayen m weeni ni la nalimnyiini. Baai meena ale a wom mi sakka de ale ta siaka ale Wen dii ale tom mi la, wa le nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. Wen a kan bu wa buusa dii nyiŋla ba poom nya nyuvuri kama.
25<<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen ku danni cheena, di be poom a paari kama ate baai ale a nye ase kpieba la ale wom Wen Nidoabinni lueluk a nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. 26Nyuvuri a nyini ka m Kowa dek jigi, dila wa basi kama ate Nidoabinni mɛ a ta nyuvuri wa po. 27Wa te mu suik kama ayen m bo nuruba buusa dii nyiŋla mi ka Saalɔbiik. 28Ni kan basi ate mi ale a weeni ni diila a cha ni. Ku danni cheena kama ate baai meena ale kpi la a wom mi lueluku a yiti kum po. 29Baai meena ale tom tuimaŋsa la, m Kowa ale basi ate ba yiti kum po abe wa pai nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la a te ba. Baai meena mɛ ale tom tuimbaata la, wa le yiti ba kum po abe wa te ba waalika.
30<<Mi an baga a tom mi dek wari ya. Mi a bo buusa ase ka Wen ale weeni mu diila. Dila m boteka ka wensie. M kan yaali ayen m va m dek yaalika, alege ka waai ale tom mu la yaalika ate mi a va.
31<<Dan ka mi nyiini ale weeni ni mi ale ka waai la, nama ate a weeni kama ayen m wieŋa daa wensie. 32Kowa a biisi mi wie, ate mi seba wa ale biisi dii meena mi nyiŋ la ka wensie.
33<<Nama dek a tom nuruba ate ba cheŋ Jɔɔn jigi ate wa biisi mi wie kama. 34Mi niŋ ka ale dii ate nuruba a biisi mi wie la, alege mi a weeni ni kama ayen ni a teeri dii ate Jɔɔn a weeni mi wie la ate ku maari ni ate ni nya varibasika. 35Jɔɔn a jam a nye ase ka zeuŋ ate ba toati ate ku a nyaksi ate wa ale biisi diila a peenti ni sue.
36<<Jɔɔn a sak nuruba mi wie, alege wie gela ale boro a sak nuruba mi wie a gaam Jɔɔn ale sak ni diila. Tuimkperikaliik sii ate mi Kowa a tom mi ayen m jam a tom la, ŋala ale a sak nuruba ayen ka wa ale waai ale tom mu la.
37<<Nama an diem a wom wa luelukwa yaase ni nya wa, alege wa kasim a sak nama mi wie kama. 38Wa tom mi ka nama jigi, alege ni ka siaka ale mi. Ka dila ale soa ate wa sinsaŋŋa a ka ni suiniimaŋa po la.
39<<Nama kasim a karim Wen Gbaŋka kama daa meena dii nyiŋla nama a poli kama ayen ka karimka ale basi ate ni nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. Alege wa gbaŋka a diem a sak nama ka mi wie, 40alege nama a kan yaali ayen ni jam mi jigi ate ni nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka. 41Mi kan yaali ayen nuruba a pak mu, 42alege mi seba kama ayen ni ka Wen yaalika ni po. 43M Kowa Wen ale tom mu ayen m jam a zaani wa naŋkula po, alege nama an tuesi mu. Alege nuru waai a dan jam wadek nyiŋ, ni a tuesi wa kama. 44Nama a yaali chaab zula teka alege ni kan yaali zula ŋaai ate Wen ale baga a te ni la. Ni be ni nye kase a ta siaka ale mi? 45Nama a kan poli ayen mi ale ta biisigaamka ale ni m Kowa niŋŋa. Nama a ta ka popola Moosis jigi ale wa le a sak ni diila. Wala ale waai ale wa biisi a gaam ni la. 46Ase ni dan jam ta siaka ale Moosis kama, ni te ta siaka ale mi kama dii nyiŋla wala ale ŋmarisi mi wie. 47Ni be le kan ta siaka ale Moosis ale ŋmarisi diila, ni le nye kase a ta siaka ale mi?>>

english_text:
Feeding Five Thousand
(Matthew 14.13-21; Mark 6.30-44; Luke 9.10-17)
1Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias. 2A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him. 3-4It was almost time for the Jewish festival of Passover, and Jesus went up on a mountain with his disciples and sat down.
5When Jesus saw the large crowd coming toward him, he asked Philip, “Where will we get enough food to feed all these people?” 6He said this to test Philip, since he already knew what he was going to do.
7Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
8Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said, 9“There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
10The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About 5,000 men were in the crowd. 11Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
12The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted. 13The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
14After the people had seen Jesus work this miracle, they began saying, “This must be the Prophet who is to come into the world!” 15Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone.
Jesus Walks on the Water
(Matthew 14.22-27; Mark 6.45-52)
16That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake. 17They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them, 18and a strong wind was making the water rough.
19When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified. 20But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!” 21The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed.
The Bread That Gives Life
22The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day 23some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks. 24They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus. 25They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
26Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted. 27 Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
28“What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
29Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
30They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do? 31 For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
32Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven. 33And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
34The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
35Jesus replied:
I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty. 36I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me. 37Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
38I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me, 39and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day. 40My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
41The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven. 42They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
43Jesus told them:
Stop grumbling! 44No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day. 45 One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
46The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father. 47I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
48I am the bread that gives life! 49Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died. 50But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die. 51I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
52They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
53Jesus answered:
I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man. 54But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day. 55My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink. 56If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
57The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me. 58The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
59Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things.
The Words of Eternal Life
60Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
61Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you? 62What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from? 63 The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit. 64But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
65Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
66Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him. 67Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him. 68 Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life. 69We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
70Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!” 71Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_text:
1Kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Yeezu yaa taam Galili Nyakpiemu kauk kunkula juijui ate ba a wi ayen Tiberiasi la. 2Nuru boari yaa va wa, dii nyiŋla ba nya Yeezu ale jam a tom wakperikaliik sii ale yuarɔma tebika la. 3Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa ga jueli kala guuk kunyi zuk. 4Gaambasika Tigini a jam moata kama. 5Yeezu yaa zak nya nuru boanni a cheena ate wa yaa bek Filip ayen, <<Ti ti nya ŋandiinta ka be a te nuru boanni nna ate ba dɛ?>> 6Wadek a jam seba dii ate wa ayen wa nye la kama, alege wa jam a yaali kama ayen wa chamsi Filip a nya. 7Filip yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ti dan kan pai ligra a gaam ŋaai ate ti ta la a da ŋandiinta ku kan paari a dɛ ba ale magadek mɛ.>> 8Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma wanyi, Simon Piita yuawa Andiru, yaa weeni Yeezu ayen, 9<<Nidoabili wanyi ale bo dela a ta borobotta tinu ale juma ŋaye, alege ŋantaŋa de a kan paari nuruma de meena.>> 10Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni basi ate nuru boanni a kali tɛŋ.>> Wuuk yegayega ale jam bo dula jigini. Nuruma yaa kali tɛŋ. Ba nidoama nyiini a jam ka tusa ŋanu (5,000). 11Yeezu yaa pai borobottaŋa ale jumaŋa a puusi a te Wen jiam ayen wa niak ŋandiintaŋa ale ge a pai chari nuruma ate ba ŋɔbi. Ba ale chari waai meena a ga nueri la, ba meena yaa ŋɔbi chak. 12Yeezu yaa weeni wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ayen, <<Ni cheŋ a ga pisi ŋandiin talaŋa ate bala a kan kaasi.>> 13Ba yaa pisi ŋandiin tii ate nuru boanni a dɛ ale tali la a sueri busisa pi ale siye. 14Nuruma ale nya wakperikaliik kaai ate Yeezu a tom la, ba yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Nuruwa de a sum ka Biisiteerɔ ale wa siŋ jam tɛŋzuk de la.>>
15Yeezu ale ga miŋ ayen ba bobi wa naab la, wa yaa yiti dula jigini a cheŋ jo guutaŋa po wadek wa nyiini.
16Wenni ale jam a siŋ la, wa ŋaaŋviirɔma yaa cheŋ nyakpiemu nɔi, 17a ga jo ŋaaruŋ po ayen ba taam kunkɔŋni ndila a ga paari Kapernaum tɛŋka. Tɛŋka ale jam a sobri la, Yeezu an diem jam ba jigi ya. 18Va kpioŋ a yaa deri yiti a fɔbi ba ŋaaruŋku ale a nye ate nyiamu a choa nna yegayega. 19Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale dam ba ŋaaruŋku a cheŋ ga paari mɛɛla ŋata yaase ŋanaansi la, ba yaa nya Yeezu ale wa bo nyiamu zuk a cheŋ cheena ba jigi. Ba le ga nya wa la, yɔgsum yaa deri yik ba. 20Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ka mi. Ni kan chali yɔgsummoa.>> 21Wa le ga paari ba ŋaaruŋku la, ba meena sue yaa peenti ate ba weeni wa ayen wa jo ŋaaruŋku po. Yeezu ale ga jo a gum ba po la, ba yaa deri paari kunkɔŋni kauk kuui ate ba a cheŋ la.
22Vari ale veenti la, nuru baai ale tali wari nyakpiemu kunkɔŋi dindila la yaa nya ayen ka ŋaaruŋ yeŋ nyini ale bo dula, Yeezu mɛ abe ka ŋaaruŋku po ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma, wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a cheŋ ka badek ba nyiini. 23Ale ge ŋaaruŋta ale nyini Tiberiasi jam moata juijui ate ba jam de ŋandiintaŋa ti Nyɔnɔwa Yeezu Kirisita a te jiamu la ŋaaŋnyiŋ. 24Nuru boanni ale nya ayen Yeezu ale wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a ka dula la, ba yaa jueli ŋaaruŋ fiisa a jam Kapernaum tɛŋka a gisi Yeezu. 25Nuruma ale ga nya Yeezu la, ba yaa bek wa ayen, <<Ti Sagrɔ, fi jam dela ka dimpo?>>
26Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen ŋandiin tii ate mi diem a te ni ate ni dɛ a chak la ale basi ate ni a gisi mu. Ni kan gisi mu ka m tuimkperikaliisaŋa miŋka nyiŋŋa. 27Ni kan basi ate ni yam meena, a bo ale ŋandiin tii ale ti jam a kaasi la, alege ni basi ate ni yam meena a bo ale ŋandiin tii ale a te nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. Tii ate Saalɔbiika ale te ni la. Ka dila ale soa ate mi a baga a pai nyuvuri dila a te ni. Wen dii ale ka mi Ko la a za ka mi ŋaaŋ ayen mi ka wa Nidoabili.>> 28Ba yaa bek wa ayen, <<Tama ayen ti nye ka sɛ a tom Wen tuini?>> 29Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni dan a yaali ayen ni nye ate Wen sui a peenti, ni ta siaka ale mi waai ate wa tom ni jigi la.>> 30Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Boan wakperikaliik ate fi ale tom ate ti nya abe ti ge a ta siaka ale fu? 31Fi seba ayen ti kokpieŋsaŋa a jam dɛ ka ŋandiinta ate ba wi ayen manna la sagni po ase ba le ŋmarisi Wen Gbaŋka po ayen, <Moosis a jam nya ka ŋandiinta wenŋmazukku po a te wa nuruma ayen ba dɛ.> >> (Yiila 78:24) 32Yeezu a ŋman weeni ba ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen Moosis an jam nya ŋandiintaŋa ka wenŋmazukku po a te ni kokpieŋsaŋa, alege ka mi Kowa Wen ale pai te ba. 33Ŋandiin tii ate Wen a te la a nye se ka waai ale nyini wenŋmazuk a jam ayen wa te tɛŋka demma nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.>> 34Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Nyɔnɔ, be kasim a te ti ŋandiintaŋa de.>>
35Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi ale nyuvuri ŋandiintaŋa, waai ale a jam mi jigi la kɔm kan yik wa, waai mɛ ale ta siaka ale mu la nyanyuila a kan yik wa. 36Mi poom liŋ weeni ayen ni nya mu kama alege ni diem ka siaka ale mu. 37Baai ate m Kowa a pai te mu la, ale jam m jigi ate m tuesi ba. Mi kan zɛri baai meena ale ba jam mi jigi la diipo diipo. 38Dii nyiŋla mi an nyini wenŋmazuk a jam ayen m tom ka mi dek ale a yaali diila alege ka Waai ale tom mu la ale a yaali diila. 39Waai ale tom mu la yaalika ale nna. Baai ate wa pai te mu la, m le nya ba zuk ate ba kan bɛ. Wa ale basi ate ba yiti kum po abe wa pai nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la a te ba. 40M Kowa yaalika ale nna ayen waai ale nya Nidoabinni ta siaka ale Wa la, ale te nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. Wa ale basi ate wa yiti kum po kpeglimka danni.>>
41Nuruma ale ga wom Yeezu ale a biisi dii ayen, <<Wa ale nyuvuri ŋandiin tii ale nyini wenŋmazuk la, ba yaa ŋuuni.>> 42Ba yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Daa Yeezu ale nna, Josefi nidoabinni? Ti seba wa kowa ale wa mawa kama. Ka boa ale soa ate wa a weeni ayen wa nyini ka wenŋmazuk a jam?>> 43Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni basi ni ŋuunika. 44Nuru waai an baga a jam Mi jigiya ka m Kowa waai ale tom mu la, dek a nin dari wa a ta jam mi jigi, ate m basi ate wa yiti kum po kpeglimka danni ate wa nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la. 45Ku ŋmarisi biisiteerɔma gbaŋka po ayen, <Naawen ale sak ba meena.> (Azaya 54:13) Baai meena ale a wom dii ate m Kowa a weeni ale a va wa sinsaŋŋa la, wa le ta ba jam Mi jigi. 46Nuru waai an diem nya mi Kowa. Mi waai ate wa tom ni jigi la, nyiini ale nya Wa. 47Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen baai meena ale ta siaka ale Mi la a poom tuesi nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la kama. 48Mi ale ŋandiin tii ale a te nyuvuri la. 49Ni kokpieŋsaŋa a jam dɛ ka ŋandiin tii ate ba a wi ayen manna la sagni po ale ge kpi, 50alege baai meena ale a dɛ nyuvuri ŋandiin tii ale nyini wenŋmazuk la, bala a kan kpi. 51Mi ale nyuvuri ŋandiin tii ale nyini wenŋmazuk a jam la. Baai meena ale a dɛ ŋandiintaŋa de la ale boro taam wuu. Ŋandiin tii ate mi ayen m pai te ba la ale M nyiŋka, ate tɛŋka demma a nya nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.>>
52Juuma yaa ta nanpaga ale chaab ayen, <<Nuruwa de ale nye ka sɛ a pai wa nyiŋka a te tama ate ti ŋɔbi?>> 53Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni, fi dan kan ŋɔbi Saalɔbiika nyiŋ lammu ale nyu wa ziimu, fi ka nyuvuri ya. 54Baai meena ale a ŋɔbi mi nyiŋka ale a nyu m ziimu la a poom tuesi wa nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la kama. M dan jam ayen m bo tɛŋzuk meena demma buusa, m le nak ba kum po a yiti. 55Mi nyiŋka ale ŋandiin maŋsaŋa dek ate M ziimu mɛ a chim nyu maŋka. 56Baai meena ale a ŋɔbi Mi nyiŋka ale a nyu Mi ziimu la a bo ale Mi kama ate Mi mɛ a bo ale ba. 57M Kowa waai ale ka nyuvuri nyɔnɔwa la, ale tom mu ni jigi. Wala nyiŋ ale soa ate mi boro. Suik kula po mɛ baai meena ale a ŋɔbi mi la, ale boro mi nyiŋ. 58Nyuvuri ŋandiintaŋa ale ŋandiin tii ate Moosis a jam pai te ni kokpieŋsaŋa ate ba dɛ ale kpi la, daa wayeŋŋa. Wen ale tom wa nyuvuri ŋandiintaŋa ate ti nyini wenŋmazuk a jam, ate baai meena ale ba dɛ ti la, a ta nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la.>>
59Yeezu a jam bo ka Juuma tuka dɔkku kuui ale bo Kapernaum tɛŋka po la, a sak wieŋa de meena.
60Yeezu ŋaaŋviirɔma yega ale jam wom dii ate wa sak la, a yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Wa sinsaŋŋa a pagra kama. Waai an baga ŋa a va.>> 61Alege Yeezu ale miŋ ayen wa ŋaaŋviirɔma a ŋuuni la, wa yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ka ni sue ale a puuri kude nyiŋŋa? 62Ase ni dan nya Mi Saalɔbiika ale m ŋmani a jueli wenŋmazuk po, ni ale poli kase? 63Waai ale a te nyuvuri la ale Wen Chiika alege nurubiik pagrim an baga a nye kude. Mi ale biisi wie ŋaai a te ni la ale a basi ate Wen Chiika a jam ni jigi. 64Alege ni gela a ka siaka ale mi ale a sak diila.>> Yeezu ale piilim a sak wa ŋaaŋviirɔma la, wa jam seba baai ale ba kan ta siaka ale wa la kama ale waai ale wa ta wa a ga bobri a sak la. 65Dula jigini Yeezu yaa ŋman weeni ba ayen, <<Ka dila ale soa ate mi a liŋ sak ni ayen nuru waai an baga a jam mi jigi ya ka M Kowa a nin dari wa a ta jam mi jigi la.>>
66Wa ŋaaŋviirɔma ale ga wom dila la, ba yega yaa deri basi wa ŋaaŋ vaka. 67Yeezu ale ga nya ba le nye diila, wa deri cheem wa ŋaaŋviirɔma pi ale bayewa jigi a bek ba ayen, <<Nama mɛ ayen ni basi mi kama?>> 68Simon Piita yaa weeni wa ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ Yeezu Kirisita, ka wana jigi ate ti a yaali ayen ti cheŋŋi? Fi ale waai ale ta Wen nyuvuri dii ale kan ta kpeglimka la sinsaŋŋa a sak ti. 69Tama abe ta siaka ale ŋa kama ale seba ayen ka fi ale Wen Nuru Weleŋka.>> 70Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi a lueri ni ka nuruba pi ale baye ayen ni chim mi ŋaaŋviirɔba, alege ni po wanyi ka jabiok.>> 71Wa jam a biisi ka Judas, Simon Iskariot nidoabinni wie. Yeezu a jam seba ayen wa le wa bobri wa a sak.

english_text:
Jesus' Brothers Don't Have Faith in Him
1Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him. 2 It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters, 3and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing. 4No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!” 5Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
6Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here. 7The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things. 8Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.” 9Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee.
Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
10After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
11During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?” 12The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.” 13But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
14When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching. 15The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
16Jesus replied:
I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me. 17If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me. 18If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie. 19Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
20The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
21Jesus answered:
I worked one miracle, and it amazed you. 22 Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons 23 in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath? 24Don't judge by appearances. Judge by what is right.
25Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill? 26Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah? 27But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
28As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him. 29But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
30Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come. 31A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!”
Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
32When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him. 33But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me. 34You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
35The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks? 36What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?”
Streams of Life-Giving Water
37 On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink! 38 Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.” 39Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory.
The People Take Sides
40When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!” 41Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee? 42 The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?” 43The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus. 44Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him.
The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
45When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
46They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
47The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled? 48Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him. 49And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
50 Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said, 51“Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
52Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.”
A Woman Caught in Sin
53Everyone else went home,
translation_text:
1Nya kude ŋaaŋnyiŋ, Yeezu yaa nyiem a gilim Galili tɛŋka. Wa jam cheŋ Judia tɛŋka dii la Juuma a gisi ka suik ayen ba ko Wa. 2Juuma Kusuŋta Tigini a jam moata kama. 3Wa suataŋa yaa jam weeni wa ayen, <<Basi dula jigini abe fi cheŋ Judia tɛŋka po, ate fi ŋaaŋviirɔma baai ale bo dula la mɛ a nya fi tuimkperikaliisaŋa sii ate fi a tom la. 4Nuru a kan suk wie ŋaai ate wa a tom la ase wa ale a yaali ayen ba seba wa. Fi abe le a tom wieŋa de la, basi ate tɛŋka meena a seba fu.>> 5Yeezu suataŋa an jam ta siaka ale wa. 6Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ku an diem magsi ayen mi cheŋ dula yɔgyɔgla de, alege nama a baga a cheŋ diipo meena ate ni a yaali la kama. 7Tɛŋka demma an kisi nama alege ba kisi mi kama, dii nyiŋla mi kasim a weeni ba ale a tom tuimbaata la. 8Nama a cheŋ Jerusalem a ga dɛ Tigini, dii nyiŋla ku an magsi ayen mi cheŋ dula jigini yɔgyɔgla de.>> 9Yeezu ale weeni nya kude la, wa yaa wari bo Galili tɛŋka po.
10Wa suataŋa ale jam basi wa ale cheŋ Tigini la, Yeezu mɛ yaa magi va ba ŋaaŋ a cheŋ. 11Juuma a jam a gisi wa kama ale a bek chaab wa boka jigi. 12Nuruba yegayega yaa jam waasi a biisi wa wie. Ba gela a jam a weeni ayen wa ka nuru maŋ, alege baai mɛ a weeni ayen wa a paasi ka nuruba. 13Ba meena a jam a chali ka Juuma kpaŋŋa yɔgsum. Ka dila ale soa ate ba an jam a biisi wa wie ate ku a jueli la.
14Tigini daaŋa ale jam a chalisi a soa se chaab la, Yeezu yaa ga jo Wen yenni po a sak nuruma. 15Wa sinsaŋŋa yaa cha Juuma kpaŋŋa baai ale jam bo dula la. Ba yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Nuruwa de a ka sagrɔ ate wa sak wa, ale nye ka sɛ a seba wieŋa de meena a sak tama?>> 16Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi sinsaŋŋa ka Wen ale tom mi la wie, ŋa daa mi dek wie. 17Baai meena ale a yaali ayen ba va Wen yaalika la, ale miŋ ase mi sinsaŋŋa a nyini ka Wen jigi yaa mi dek. 18Nuru waai ale a biisi wadek wie la a yaali kama ayen nuruba a te wa zula. Nuru waai ale a yaali ayen wa a te waai ale tom Wa la zula la, wala ka wensie nyɔnɔ. Venta a ka wa jigiya. 19Moosis an te ni Wen Sinsaŋŋa? Alege ni waai a kan zuli ŋa. Ka boa ale soa ate ni a yaali ayen ni ko mu?>>
20Nuru yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi ta ka chichirik, kaai ale a yaali ayen ka ko fu?>> 21Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi tom ka wakperikaliik kanyi ate ku cha ni nna yegayega. 22Moosis a sak ni kama ayen ni a gebi ni bisaŋa yoaŋa alege ka ni kokpieŋsaŋa ale a piilim ku, ate nama a gebi biik yoari Vuusum Danni po. 23Nama abe dan nye dila Vuusum Danni po alege an nye kaasi Moosis Sinsaŋŋa ka boa ale soa ate nama sue a puuri ale mi, m le tebi nuruwa Vuusum Danni la? 24Ni kan nya nuruba nyeela a bo buusa, alege ni a bo wensie buusa.>>
25Nuru baai ale jam bo Jerusalem tɛŋka po la, ba gela yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Daa nuruwa de ate kpaŋŋa a yaali ayen ba ko la? 26Ni be nya, wa le la a za peelimmu po a sak nuruma alege ti kpaŋŋa an nye wa wari ya. Ba baga a seba ayen wa sum ka Kirisitawa? 27Kirisitawa a dan jam, waai a kan seba wa ale nyini juijui la. Alege tama meena seba nuruwa de ale nyini juijui la kama.>> 28Yeezu ale diem jam bo Wen yenni po a sak nuruma la, wa yaa weeni ate ku jueli ayen, <<Nama a seba mi ale nyini juijui la? Mi an jam daa m dek nyiŋŋa. Waai ale tom mu la ka wensie nyɔnɔ. Ni abe zɛ wa, 29alege mi ale seba wa. Mi ale wa a jam bo ka jigi yeŋ ale ge ate wa tom mi ni jigi.>> 30Nuruma gela ale wom dii ate wa weeni la, ba yaa jam a yaali ayen ba yik wa alege nuru an pai nisa a tiri wa diila wa yikka danni an diem paari ya. 31Nuru boanni po yega a jam ta siaka ale wa, a yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Ase Kirisitawa a dan poom jam, wa le baga a tom wakperikaliisa a gaam nuruwa de?>>
32Farisiima ale wom nuru boanni ale a waasi Yeezu wie diila, ba le kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa a yaa wi chaab a biisi alege a tom badek nuruba ayen ba ga yik Yeezu. 33Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi le bo ale ni daa maga dega abe m ge a ŋman cheŋ waai ale tom mu la jigi. 34Ni le nyiem a gisi mi boka jigi, alege ni kan ŋman nya mu dii nyiŋla ni kan baga a cheŋ juijui ate mi a cheŋ la.>> 35Juuma yaa bek chaab ayen, <<Wa ti a yaali ayen wa cheŋ ka Girik tɛŋsaŋa ate tama nuruma a maa boro la a sak Girik demma yaa? 36Wa weeni ti ayen ti le nyiem a gisi wa boka jigi, alege ti kan ŋman nya wa. Wa ŋman weeni ti mɛ ayen ti kan baga a cheŋ juijui ate wa a cheŋ la. Nya kude kiri ale boa?>>
37Juuma Tigini dai dii dai dek ale jam a kpeglim la, dai kpien dila Yeezu yaa yiti a zaani nuru boanni niŋ a weeni ate ku jueli ayen, <<Baai meena ate nyanyuila a ta ba la, a jam mi jigi ate m te ba nyiam ate ba nyu. 38Ba ŋmarisi Wen Gbaŋka po ayen, <Nyiam ale nyini baai ale ta siaka ale mi la suiniima po a kasim chali a nyini.> >> 39Yeezu ale biisi ale ba dii nyiamu jigi la, a magsi chaab ale ka Wen Chiika. Wen an diem a pai wa Chiika a te baai ale ta siaka ale Yeezu la, dii nyiŋla Yeezu an diem yiti jueli Wen jigi ya.
40Nuru boanni ale wom dii ate Yeezu a weeni la, ba gela yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Nuruwa de a sum ka Biisiteerɔwa.>> 41Ba gela mɛ a weeni ayen, <<Ka wala ale Kirisitawa.>> Mbala mɛ a weeni ayen, <<Kirisitawa an baga a chim Galili denɔ. 42Ba ŋmarisi Wen Gbaŋka po ayen, <Kirisitawa ale chim ka Deevid ŋaaŋbiik. Ba le biak wa ka Betiliyem, tɛŋ kaai ate Deevid nyini la.> >> 43Nya kude meena yaa jam basi ate nuru boanni a poori chaab nna tɔgatɔga. 44Ba gela a jam a yaali kama ayen ba yik wa, alege nuru waai an jam a tiri wa.
45Kpaga ŋaai ate ba jam tom la yaa ŋman cheŋ kaabteerɔ kpaŋŋa ale Farisiima jigi ate ba bek ba ayen, <<Ka boa ate ni an ta wa jam ya?>>
46Nuruma yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nuruwa de biika, tama an diem maa wom ka choa.>> 47Farisiima yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Wa sum a maa paasi nama mɛ kama? 48Nama diem a wom ale kpaŋŋa yaase Farisiima wanyi a ta siaka ale wa. 49Alege nuru boanni baai ale kan seba Moosis Sinsaŋŋa la, kikaasa ale bo ba zuk.>> 50Nikodimusi waai ale jam liŋ biisi ale Yeezu la a jam maa ka Farisiima po wanyi. Wa yaa weeni wa vaanchaama ayen, 51<<Tama Sinsaŋŋa a sak ti kama ayen ti dan kan dɛ niŋ a bo nuru buusa a wom wadek nɔi po ti an baga a weeni ayen wa biisi lo ya.>> 52Ba yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi mɛ a nyini ka Galili tɛŋka? Be nya Wen Gbaŋka po ate fi miŋ ayen biisiteerɔ an nyini Galili tɛŋka.>> 53Ba meena yaa yiti a waaŋ chaab a kuli ba yeeŋa.

english_text:
1but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives. 2Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
3The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd. 4Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband. 5 The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
6They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
7 They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!” 8Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground. 9The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
10Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
11“No sir,” the woman answered.
Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.”
Jesus Is the Light for the World
12 Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
13 The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
14Jesus replied:
Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going. 15You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone. 16If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me. 17 Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true. 18I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
19“Where is your Father?” they asked.
“You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
20Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come.
You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
21Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
22The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
23Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't. 24This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
25“Who are you?” they asked Jesus.
Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning. 26There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
27No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
28Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me. 29The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
30After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him.
The Truth Will Set You Free
31Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples. 32 You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
33 They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
34Jesus replied:
I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin! 35And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family. 36If the Son gives you freedom, you are free! 37I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts. 38I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you.
Your Father Is the Devil
39The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!”
Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did. 40Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that. 41But you are doing exactly what your father does.”
“Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
42Jesus answered:
If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own. 43Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying? 44 Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
45Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me. 46Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth. 47Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God.
Jesus and Abraham
48The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
49Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me. 50I don't want honor for myself. But there is one who wants me to be honored, and he is also the one who judges. 51I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
52Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die? 53Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
54Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God, 55even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says. 56Your father Abraham was really glad to see me.”
57“You are not even 50 years old!” they said. “How could you have seen Abraham?”
58Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.” 59The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_text:
1Yeezu yaa basi dula jigini ale cheŋ ga jueli Olivi Guuku zuk. 2Vari ale veenti la saluik wa yaa ŋman siŋ ga jo Wen yenni po. Nuru boari yaa ŋman tigsi gilim wa ate wa yaa kala a sak ba. 3Sinsak sagrɔma ale Farisiima yaa yik nipok ale wa boro a nye kaboŋ a ta wa jam zaan ba suŋsuŋ. 4Ba weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Sagrɔ, tama yik nipowa de ale wa boro a nye ka kaboŋ. 5Sinsaŋŋa po Moosis a weeni ti kama ayen ti yuk kula choa nyɔnɔ ale tana a ko. Fi ale weeni wa ayen ka boa?>> 6Ba bek wa dila kama ayen ba chamsi wa nya ate wa dan tulisi bɛ abe ba weeni ayen wa kaasi ya. Alege Yeezu an jam tulisi ba a yaa le ge a koori tɛŋ a pai wa nandub a ŋmarisi tɛŋ. 7Ba le diem za a bek wa la, wa yaa yiti nya ba ale weeni ayen, <<Nuru waai dek ale seba ayen wa an diem maa tom tuimbiok nya la, wala dek abe liŋ a pai tintain a yuk nipowa.>> 8Wa le weeni dila la, wa yaa ŋman koori tɛŋ a ŋmarisi. 9Ba le wom wa wieŋa la, ba yaa waaŋ chaab wanyi wanyi, ŋankpagsaŋa a dɛ niŋ ate mbala a pai saŋ. Ba yaa jam tali ka Yeezu ale nipowa nyiini dula jigini. 10Yeezu yaa ŋman yiti ŋmai a nya nipowa ale bek wa ayen, <<Ba bo ka be? Nuru waai a karo ayen wa bo mini fu?>> 11Nipowa yaa weeni Yeezu ayen, <<M Nyɔnɔ, waai karo.>> Yeezu yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Mi mɛ a kan bo mini fu. Be cheŋ a kuli abe fi kan ŋman tom tuimbaata.>>
12Yeezu yaa ŋman biisi ale ba ayen, <<Mi ale tɛŋzuk de Bolimu. Baai meena ale a va mi la a kan ŋman a cheŋŋi legi po. Ba ale ta ka Bolim buui ale a te nyuvuri la.>> 13Farisiima yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi a biisi ka fidek wie fi ale a biisi diila daa wensie.>> 14Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi a daa biisi ka m dek wie ku ka wensie dii nyiŋla m seba m le nyini juijui la kama ale a ŋman seba m le a cheŋ juijui la mɛ. Nama zɛ mi ale nyini juijui la yaase m le a cheŋ juijui la. 15Nama a nya ka nyiŋ lammu a bo buusa, mi kan nye dila. 16Ase mi dan poom a bo nuru waai buusa, m buusaŋa ka wensie, dii nyiŋla daa mi nyiini ale a bo buusaŋa, m Kowa waai ale tom mu la a bo ale mu kama. 17Ba ŋmarisi ni sinsaŋŋa po kama ayen nuruba baye a dan siak a ta nɔiyeŋ ale chaab wari nyiŋ, ba wanni ka wensie. 18Mi a biisi ka m dek wari, m Kowa waai ale tom mu la mɛ a biisi ka mi wari.>> 19Ba yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi Kowa bo ka be?>> Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni zɛ mi yaase m Kowa, ni dan seba mi ni seba m Kowa mɛ kama.>> 20Yeezu a jam kala ka Wen yenni po a moata juijui ate nuruma a nyiem a pai ba ligraŋa a ta jam a nyoro a te Wen la a sak nuru boanni wieŋa de meena. Nuru waai an jam yik wa dii nyiŋla wa yikka danni an diem paari ya.
21Yeezu a ŋman weeni ba ayen, <<Mi a gomsi kama ayen m cheŋ jigi. M daa cheŋ, ni kan baga a va mu a cheŋŋi. Nama ale nyiem a gisi mu, alege ni le kpi ale ni tuimbaataŋa.>> 22Juuma yaa weeni chaab ayen, <<Wa a yaali ayen wa ko ka wa dega? Wa a le weeni tama ayen ti kan baga a cheŋ wa ale a cheŋ juijui la.>> 23Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Nama ka tɛŋzuk de nuruba, alege mi nyini ka wenŋmazuk, nama nyini ka tɛŋzuk de alege mi an nyini tɛŋzuk de. 24Dila ale soa ate mi a weeni ayen ni le kpi ale ni tuimbaataŋa la. Ni le kpi ni tuimbaataŋa po ka nama a nin ta siaka ale mi le weeni ayen mi ka waai la.>> 25Ba yaa bek wa ayen, <<Fi ka wana?>> Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Mi poom a liŋ weeni ni mi ale ka waai la kama. 26M ta ka wie yegayega m weeni ayen ni kaasi ya. Waai ale tom mu la ka wensie nyɔnɔ, mi me a sak tɛŋzuk de nuruma ka dii nyiini ate m wom m Kowa jigi la.>> 27Juuma an diem a jam miŋ ayen Yeezu a jam a sak ba ka wa Kowa Wen wie. 28Wa yaa ŋman weeni ba ayen, <<Ni dan jam yik Mi Saalɔbiika a kpi jabarimu nyiŋ, ni le miŋ mi ale a weeni ayen mi ka waai la, ate ni seba ayen mi a kan nye wari ale m dek pagrimoa. Alege mi a biisi ka m Kowa ale sak mu diila. 29Waai ale tom mu la dek a bo ale mu kama wa an basi mu m dek m nyiini dii nyiŋla m kasim a tom ka dii ale a peenti wa sui la.>> 30Yeezu ale biisi nueri la, nuruba yega yaa jam ta siaka ale wa.
31Yeezu yaa ŋman weeni Juuma ale jam ta siaka ale wa la ayen, <<Ni dan va mi wensie sinsaŋŋa de, ni le chim mi ŋaaŋviirɔ maŋsa. 32Ni le seba wensieŋa ate wensieŋa a vari ni basi.>> 33Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Tama ka ti kokpieŋka Abrayam ŋaaŋbisa, alege ti an diem a chim nuruba yɔm a nya ya. Fi ale a weeni ti dii ayen fi wensieŋa ale vari ti yɔntiri po a basi la kiri ale boa?>>
34Yeezu yaa jam tulisi ba ayen, <<Wensie ate mi a weeni ni ayen waai ale a nye biem la, a chim ka yɔma a te biem. 35Yɔma a kan bo yeri po taam wuu, alege yenni nidoabinni a bo di po kama taam wuu. 36Mi, Wen Nidoabinni, a dan vari fu a basi fi sum a nya varibasika kama. 37Mi seba ayen ni ka Abrayam ŋaaŋbisa, alege ni a yaali ayen ni ko mu, dii nyiŋla ni kan yaali ayen ni wom m sinsaŋŋa. 38Mi a biisi ka mi ale nya dii m kowa jigi la alege nama a biisi ni kowa ale weeni diila.>>
39Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Ka Abrayam ale tama ko.>> Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Abrayam a dan sum ka nama ko, ku te a fɛ kama ayen ni va wa wamaŋsaŋa. 40Nama a yaali kama ayen ni ko mu, dii nyiŋla mi ale a sak ni wensie wie ŋaai ate Wen a sak mu la. Abrayam an jam baga a nye nya kude. 41Ba yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi a nye ka fi kowa ale jam nye diila. Tama daa baai ale a goa ale nipooba a basi du la ale biak tama, tama ta ka ko yeŋ, wala ale Wen.>> 42Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ase Wen a dan sum ka nama Ko, nama a te a yaali mi kama, dii nyiŋla mi nyini ka wa jigi. Mi an jam ka m dek nyiŋŋa, alege ka Wen ale tom mu. 43Ka boa ate nama an baga a wom mi sinsaŋŋa? Dii nyiŋla ni zɛri ŋa womka kama. 44Ni ka ni kowa jabioku bisa ate ni a yaali ayen ni a va wa yaalika. A nyini piilimka po wa ka nuru koorik. Wa an maa va wensie siuwa dii nyiŋla wensie ka wa jigi ya. Wa daa velim wa a nye dila kama diila venta a piilim ka wa jigi ale chim venta ko. 45Mi a sak ni ka wensie, alege nama ka siaka ale mi ale a weeni ni diila. 46Nama waai a ka dela a baga a sak mu wa dii ate mi a nye kaasi la. Ase mi a dan kasim a sak ni ka wensie, ka boa abe le soa ate nama a kan ta siaka ale dii ate mi a sak ni la? 47Baai ale ka Wen bisa la a wom wa ale a weeni ba diila kama. Nama ale kan a yaali ayen ni wom Wen wieŋa diila a sak kama ayen ni daa wa bisa.>>
48Juuma yaa weeni Yeezu ayen, <<Tama ale weeni ayen fi ka Samaria denɔ ate chichirik biok a bo fi zukku po la, daa wensie?>> 49Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Chichirik biok a ka mi zukku po. Mi a te m Kowa zula kama, alege nama a kan te mi zula. 50Mi a kan yaali zula a te m dega, alege ka m Kowa nyiini, wa abe ni wa bo baai ale zɛri mu la buusa. 51Wensie ate mi a weeni ni, waai ale a va mi sinsaŋŋa la num kan tu kummoa.>> 52Juuma yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Yɔgyɔgla de ti sum seba kama ayen chichirik biok ale bo fi po, ti kokpieŋka Abrayam ale Wen biisiteerɔma meena a kpi kama. Alege fi a weeni ti ayen baai meena ale a va fi sinsaŋŋa la a kan maa kpi. 53Ti kokpieŋka Abrayam kpi kama. Fi a poli ayen fi zuak a gaam wa kama. Wen biisiteerɔma mɛ a kpi, fi a poli ayen fi ka wana?>> 54Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ase mi a dan yaali ka zula a te m dek zula ŋala a kan ta kiri ya. Waai ale a te mi zula la ale m Kowa waai dek ate nama a wi ayen ni Wen la. 55Nama a zɛ wa, alege mi a seba wa kama. Mi a dan weeni ayen m zɛ wa, m ka velimvendik ase nama la. M seba wa kama ale a va Wa sinsaŋŋa. 56Nama kokpieŋka Abrayam ale jam nya mu ale m cheena tɛŋzuk de la, wa sui a jam peenti kama nna yegayega.>> 57Juuma yaa weeni wa ayen, <<Fi an diem a paari bena pisinu ale nye ka sɛ a seba Abrayam?>> 58Yeezu yaa weeni ba ayen, <<Ni wom dii ate mi a yaali ayen m weeni a sak ni la nalimnyiini. Mi poom jam liŋ boro kama ale ge ate ba biak Abrayam.>> 59Juuma ale ga wom nya kude la, ba yaa pisi tintana ayen ba yuk wa, alege Yeezu suk taam nyini Wen yenni po a nyini.

english_text:
Jesus Heals a Man Born Blind
1As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth. 2Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
3“No, it wasn't!” Jesus answered. “But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him. 4As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work. 5 While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
6After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes. 7Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
8The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man. 9Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
10“Then how can you see?” they asked.
